```text
# Issue Description

## Summary

Excalidraw currently offers a limited selection of fonts for text elements. Giving the user the option to add their own custom fonts, including fonts that support a wider variety of both languages and writing systems, would give users greater control and flexibility when creating diagrams

## User Story

**As a** user, **I want** more font options for text elements **so that** I can customize the appearance of my text and better support the languages I use.

**As a ** user, **I want** more font options for text elements **so that** I can customize the appearance of both my text and my graphics better, and support all of the languages that I or my collaborators use.

## User Scenario
A user creates or selects a text element in Excalidraw. They open the text selection menu, and access the new add text button, and upload a WOFF2 file containing their preferred script. The newly uploaded font is now available in the font the selection menu, and it is applied to the text element, allowing the user to customize its appearance and, if/when supported by the font, display characters from different alphabets/writing systems.

---

# Issue Classification

## Scope

**Generic:** Medium
**Specific:** Medium (suggested: 5 points)

**Reason:**
Requires reading in suitable fonts with appropriate licensing from WOFF2 (or WOFF files maybe) and integrating them into Excalidraw's existing text-rendering and font-selection workflows, while also verifying that existing text behavior remains functional under multiple scenarios.

---

# Expectations

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] **Criteria A:  Font Addition.** Users are able to freely add fonts with a corresponding WOFF file
- [ ]  **Criteria B: Font Selection Expansion.** Users are able to access the newly added fonts through a simple scroll on a 'fonts' dialogue
- [ ] **Criteria C: Font Rendering.** Newly added fonts render correctly  in both the editor and in exported drawings
- [ ] **Criteria D: Licensing.** Systems, or warnings in place to ensure that users only add/work with correctly licensed fonts, and don't distribute content  using unlicensed fonts
- [ ] **Criteria E: Additional Characters** Characters from additional writing systems render correctly.

## Open Questions
-Should there be a mechanism for removing additionally added fonts?
-Should support be added for filetypes other than WOFF2/WOFF?
-How should Excalidraw handle characters that aren't supported by the selected font?
-Should custom fonts be available to all collaborators in a single workspace? If so, how should the loading process look?

---

# Extra

## Out of Scope

- Implementing a dedicated Unicode character picker.
- Changing how text elements interact with other elements.
- Building a custom font editor or creating original typefaces.

## Head Issue

Issue (#40): Add More Fonts
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-13 00:42:21Z)**_

Issue #140 is "Add More Font Options": users upload their own WOFF2/WOFF font, pick it in the font picker, and it renders in both the editor and exports. It also asks for a licensing safeguard and for non-Latin scripts to work.

## What the code does today

- **Font IDs are fixed.** `FONT_FAMILY` in [constants.ts:130](packages/common/src/constants.ts#L130) is a fixed map of names to numeric IDs (1–10). `FontFamilyValues` ([types.ts:21](packages/element/src/types.ts#L21)) only accepts those exact numbers. Fallback fonts already use 100 and 998–1000, so custom fonts need their own number range, for example 2000 and up.
- **Font registration can't happen at runtime.** [Fonts.ts](packages/excalidraw/fonts/Fonts.ts) has a static registry, but `register()` is private and only runs during `init()`. We need a public way to add a font while the app is running.
- **SVG export may already work.** [export.ts:439](packages/excalidraw/scene/export.ts#L439) embeds every font in the registry via `generateFontFaceDeclarations`. If a custom font is registered with a data URL, SVG export should just work. PNG export draws on a canvas, so it depends on `document.fonts`.
- **Loading a scene matches fonts by name.** [restore.ts:288](packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts#L288) only recognises names in `FONT_FAMILY`. It needs to keep custom font IDs when the scene includes the font's data.
- **The picker uses a hardcoded list.** [FontPickerList.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/FontPicker/FontPickerList.tsx) switches on `FONT_FAMILY` values for icons and names.

## Proposed commit steps

1. **Data model.** Define a custom font ID range and widen `FontFamilyValues` to accept those IDs. Add a `CustomFont` type: `{ id, name, dataURL, mimeType, licenseAcknowledged }`. Make sure `getFontString` and the fallback logic handle custom IDs. Add unit tests.
2. **Runtime registration.** Add `Fonts.registerCustomFont(font)` and `unregisterCustomFont(id)`, built on `ExcalidrawFontFace` with a data URL. Test that registered fonts appear in `Fonts.registered` and in the generated font declarations.
3. **Upload and validation.** Accept `.woff2`/`.woff` files, read them as data URLs, and check them by loading with the browser's `FontFace` API. Show an error on bad files and enforce a size limit.
4. **Licensing (Criteria D).** Show a confirmation dialog on upload ("I have the right to use and embed this font"), stored as `licenseAcknowledged`. On export, warn if the scene uses custom fonts.
5. **Picker UI (Criteria A/B).** Add an "Upload font…" entry and a "Custom" section to the font picker list. Selecting a font applies it to the selected text, with the usual undo/redo behaviour.
6. **Saving and loading.** Save custom fonts with the scene (`.excalidraw` JSON and the app's local storage). Register them on load before text is measured. Update `restore.ts` so it doesn't reset custom IDs.
7. **Export (Criteria C).** Check that the font is embedded in SVG exports and that PNG and clipboard exports wait for it to load. Add export tests.
8. **Other writing systems (Criteria E).** Make sure characters missing from the custom font fall back cleanly (Xiaolai for CJK, then sans-serif and emoji). Test with Cyrillic, Arabic and CJK text.
9. **(Optional) Removing fonts.** Let users delete a custom font. Text that uses it falls back to the default font.

## Open questions for you

The issue leaves these open:

- **Removing fonts:** should step 9 be in scope?
- **File types:** should we also accept TTF/OTF? This costs almost nothing, since `FontFace` loads them all.
- **Collaboration:** should custom fonts sync to other people in a live session? I'd keep that out of scope and only save fonts in the scene file. Live sync would mean changes to the collab and Firebase file storage.
- **Licensing:** is a checkbox confirmation enough? Reading the font's embedding permissions from the file is possible for WOFF, but WOFF2 is Brotli-compressed, so that would take more work.

Once you've answered these, I'll create a branch and start on step 1. I'll stop after each step so you can review and commit.

```text
export function getGenericFontFamilyFallback(
  fontFamily: number,
): keyof typeof FONT_FAMILY_GENERIC_FALLBACKS {
  switch (fontFamily) {
    case FONT_FAMILY.Cascadia:
    case FONT_FAMILY["Comic Shanns"]:
      return MONOSPACE_GENERIC_FONT;

    default:
      return SANS_SERIF_GENERIC_FONT;
  }
}

export const getFontFamilyFallbacks = (
  fontFamily: number,
): Array<keyof typeof FONT_FAMILY_FALLBACKS> => {
  const genericFallbackFont = getGenericFontFamilyFallback(fontFamily);

  switch (fontFamily) {
    case FONT_FAMILY.Excalifont:
      return [
        CJK_HAND_DRAWN_FALLBACK_FONT,
        genericFallbackFont,
        WINDOWS_EMOJI_FALLBACK_FONT,
      ];
    default:
      return [genericFallbackFont, WINDOWS_EMOJI_FALLBACK_FONT];
  }
```

```text
// for versioning and such.
// note: hashes individual code units (not code points),
// but for hashing purposes this is fine as it iterates through every code unit
// (as such, no need to encode to byte string first)
export const hashString = (s: string): number => {
  let hash: number = 5381;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    const char: number = s.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = (hash << 5) + hash + char;
  }
  return hash >>> 0; // Ensure unsigned 32-bit integer
};
```

```typescript
import {
  CUSTOM_FONT_FAMILY_ID_START,
  FONT_FAMILY,
  FONT_FAMILY_FALLBACKS,
  getCustomFontFamilyName,
  getFontFamilyString,
  getFontString,
  isCustomFontFamily,
} from "@excalidraw/common";

describe("custom font families (#140)", () => {
  describe("isCustomFontFamily()", () => {
    it("rejects every built-in and fallback font id", () => {
      for (const id of [
        ...Object.values(FONT_FAMILY),
        ...Object.values(FONT_FAMILY_FALLBACKS),
      ]) {
        expect(isCustomFontFamily(id)).toBe(false);
      }
    });

    it("accepts ids from the custom range start upwards", () => {
      expect(isCustomFontFamily(CUSTOM_FONT_FAMILY_ID_START)).toBe(true);
      expect(isCustomFontFamily(CUSTOM_FONT_FAMILY_ID_START + 12345)).toBe(
        true,
      );
    });

    it("rejects non-integer and non-finite values", () => {
      expect(isCustomFontFamily(CUSTOM_FONT_FAMILY_ID_START + 0.5)).toBe(false);
      expect(isCustomFontFamily(Infinity)).toBe(false);
      expect(isCustomFontFamily(NaN)).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe("getFontFamilyString()", () => {
    it("maps custom ids to their CSS family name followed by fallbacks", () => {
      const id = CUSTOM_FONT_FAMILY_ID_START + 7;

      expect(getFontFamilyString({ fontFamily: id })).toBe(
        `${getCustomFontFamilyName(id)}, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji`,
      );
    });

    it("leaves built-in font strings unchanged", () => {
      expect(getFontFamilyString({ fontFamily: FONT_FAMILY.Nunito })).toBe(
        "Nunito, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji",
      );
    });

    it("includes the custom family in getFontString()", () => {
      const id = CUSTOM_FONT_FAMILY_ID_START;

      expect(getFontString({ fontSize: 20, fontFamily: id })).toBe(
        `20px ${getCustomFontFamilyName(id)}, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji`,
      );
    });
  });
});
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-13 00:56:42Z)**_

Step 1 is done on the new branch `feat/issue-140-custom-fonts`. The new tests and the existing common tests pass (16 total), typecheck is clean, and Prettier passes on the changed files. I didn't run the full suite. Nothing is committed.

**What changed:**

- **[constants.ts](packages/common/src/constants.ts):**
  - Custom fonts get IDs from 2000 up (`CUSTOM_FONT_FAMILY_ID_START`), well clear of the built-in and fallback IDs.
  - `CUSTOM_FONT_MIME_TYPES` lists only `font/woff` and `font/woff2`, matching your no-TTF/OTF decision.
  - `isCustomFontFamily(id)` checks whether an ID is in the custom range.
  - `getCustomFontFamilyName(id)` builds the CSS name, e.g. `ExcalidrawCustomFont-2007`. It's based on the ID rather than the name the user types, so it can't clash with a built-in font or produce invalid CSS.
- **[utils.ts](packages/common/src/utils.ts):** `getFontFamilyString` now returns that CSS name plus the normal fallbacks for custom IDs. The canvas, SVG export, text editor and picker preview all get it through this one function.
- **[types.ts](packages/excalidraw/types.ts):** new `CustomFontData` type (`{ id, name, mimeType, dataURL, licenseAcknowledged, created }`) and a `CustomFonts` record keyed by ID.
- **[customFonts.test.ts](packages/common/src/customFonts.test.ts):** 6 tests for the ID range check and the font strings.

**Notes:**

- `FontFamilyValues` is already plain `number`, because `FONT_FAMILY` isn't declared `as const`, so the type didn't need widening.
- Text layout falls back to Excalifont's metrics for unknown IDs. Custom fonts will lay out reasonably without us reading metrics from the font file, which matters because WOFF2 is compressed.
- **Decision for step 3:** I'd make the ID a hash of the font file's contents instead of counting up from 2000. Then the same font gets the same ID in every scene, and copying text between scenes won't mix up two different fonts that happen to share an ID. The existing `hashString` in `@excalidraw/element` can do this.

I saved your answers to the open questions to memory. Suggested commit message: `feat(fonts): add custom font id range and CustomFontData type (#140)`.

Next is step 2: adding `Fonts.registerCustomFont` and `unregisterCustomFont` at runtime. Let me know when you've committed and I'll start it.

```powershell
function Mutate($file, $from, $to) {
  $path = (Resolve-Path $file).Path
```

Changing the start from 2000 to 1001 passes all 6 tests, because nothing tests IDs between the highest fallback ID (1000) and 2000.

It doesn't break anything today: any start above 1000 keeps custom IDs clear of the built-in ones. It would matter only if the range ever needed to be exactly 2000, for example to leave room for future built-in fonts.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-13 01:06:12Z)**_

For step 1, no. For the later steps, yes.

**Why manual is enough for step 1:** the new code is about five lines across three tiny functions. Stryker would generate roughly the same 8–10 mutants we already ran, and getting it working would take longer than that.

**Why Stryker pays off from step 2:** the upcoming code is much bigger, including the runtime registration in `Fonts.ts`, the upload checks, the scene-loading changes in `restore.ts` and the picker logic. Hand-picking mutants there is slow and you'd likely miss some. Stryker generates every operator, boundary, boolean and string mutant automatically. Its HTML report shows each surviving mutant on the line where it lives, and that maps directly onto the "Source of expected value" column in the Test Evidence section.

**What it would take to set up:** your current [stryker.config.json](dev-docs/stryker.config.json) was generated for Jest/create-react-app, so it won't run this repo's tests. You'd need a separate config at the repo root, something like:

```json
{
  "testRunner": "vitest",
  "vitest": { "configFile": "vitest.config.mts" },
  "mutate": [
    "packages/common/src/constants.ts:145-165",
    "packages/common/src/utils.ts:96-112"
  ],
  "coverageAnalysis": "perTest",
  "reporters": ["clear-text", "html", "progress"]
}
```

- **Scoping matters.** Without `mutate` line ranges, Stryker would mutate all of `constants.ts`, generating hundreds of mutants for code that isn't ours.
- **Run only our tests.** Stryker should run only the custom-font test files, not the full suite. Your memory notes say the full suite times out and deletes snapshots, so running it once per mutant would be painful.
- **The Vitest runner is already installed.** `@stryker-mutator/vitest-runner` is in `dev-docs`, but it may need adding at the repo root, which changes `package.json` and `yarn.lock`.

I'd keep doing step 1 by hand and set up a scoped Stryker config at the start of step 2. Should I prepare it so it doesn't touch any tracked files, or do you want it committed to the repo?

```text
205	    const concurrency = 3;
206	    const fontFaces = await new PromisePool(iterator, concurrency).all();

208	    // dedup just in case (i.e. could be the same font faces with 0 glyphs)
209	    return Array.from(new Set(fontFaces));

212	  private static async loadFontFaces(
213	    fontFamilies: Array<ExcalidrawTextElement["fontFamily"]>,
214	    charsPerFamily: Record<number, Set<string>>,
215	  ) {
216	    // add all registered font faces into the `document.fonts` (if not added already)
217	    for (const { fontFaces, metadata } of Fonts.registered.values()) {
218	      // skip registering font faces for local fonts (i.e. Helvetica)
219	      if (metadata.local) {
220	        continue;
221	      }
222
223	      for (const { fontFace } of fontFaces) {
224	        if (!window.document.fonts.has(fontFace)) {
225	          window.document.fonts.add(fontFace);
226	        }
227	      }
228	    }
229
230	    // loading 10 font faces at a time, in a controlled manner
231	    const iterator = Fonts.fontFacesLoader(fontFamilies, charsPerFamily);
232	    const concurrency = 10;
233	    const fontFaces = await new PromisePool(iterator, concurrency).all();
234	    return fontFaces.flat().filter(Boolean);
235	  }

237	  private static *fontFacesLoader(
238	    fontFamilies: Array<ExcalidrawTextElement["fontFamily"]>,
239	    charsPerFamily: Record<number, Set<string>>,
240	  ): Generator<Promise<void | readonly [number, FontFace[]]>> {
241	    for (const [index, fontFamily] of fontFamilies.entries()) {
242	      const font = getFontString({
243	        fontFamily,
244	        fontSize: FONT_SIZES.sm,
245	      });
246
247	      // WARN: without "text" param it does not have to mean that all font faces are loaded as it could be just one irrelevant font face!
248	      // instead, we are always checking chars used in the family, so that no required font faces remain unloaded
249	      const text = Fonts.getCharacters(charsPerFamily, fontFamily);
250
251	      if (!window.document.fonts.check(font, text)) {
252	        yield promiseTry(async () => {
253	          try {
254	            // WARN: browser prioritizes loading only font faces with unicode ranges for characters which are present in the document (html & canvas), other font faces could stay unloaded
255	            // we might want to retry here, i.e.  in case CDN is down, but so far I didn't experience any issues - maybe it handles retry-like logic under the hood
256	            const fontFaces = await window.document.fonts.load(font, text);
257
258	            return [index, fontFaces];
259	          } catch (e) {
260	            // don't let it all fail if just one font fails to load
261	            console.error(
262	              `Failed to load font "${font}" from urls "${Fonts.registered
263	                .get(fontFamily)
264	                ?.fontFaces.map((x) => x.urls)}"`,
265	              e,
266	            );
267	          }
268	        });
269	      }
270	    }
271	  }

277	    for (const [familyIndex, family] of families.entries()) {
278	      const { fontFaces, metadata } = Fonts.registered.get(family) ?? {};
279
280	      if (!Array.isArray(fontFaces)) {
281	        console.error(

306

311	              error,
312	            );
313	          }
314	        });
315	      }
316	    }
317	  }
```

```text
const getFontFamilyIcon = (fontFamily: FontFamilyValues): JSX.Element => {
  switch (fontFamily) {
    case FONT_FAMILY.Excalifont:
    case FONT_FAMILY.Virgil:
      return FreedrawIcon;
    case FONT_FAMILY.Nunito:
    case FONT_FAMILY.Helvetica:
      return FontFamilyNormalIcon;
    case FONT_FAMILY["Lilita One"]:
      return FontFamilyHeadingIcon;
    case FONT_FAMILY["Comic Shanns"]:
    case FONT_FAMILY.Cascadia:
      return FontFamilyCodeIcon;
    default:
      return FontFamilyNormalIcon;
  }
};

const getFontFamilyLabel = (
  fontFamily: FontFamilyValues,
  fontFaces: ExcalidrawFontFace[],
) =>
  // prefer our config as the browser resolved names may be wrapped in quotes and such
  Object.entries(FONT_FAMILY).find(([, id]) => id === fontFamily)?.[0] ??
  fontFaces[0]?.fontFace?.family ??
  "Unknown";
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-13 01:14:48Z)**_

Only at a high level. The button came up in the original plan, but we never pinned down its details.

**What we've covered so far:**

- **The issue's scenario:** the user opens the font picker, clicks a new "add font" button, uploads a WOFF2 file, and the font appears in the picker and is applied to the selected text.
- **My step 5 outline:** an "Upload font…" entry and a "Custom" section in the font picker list.
- **Your decisions:**
  - WOFF/WOFF2 only.
  - A license checkbox when uploading, plus a warning on export.
  - Removing fonts is in scope.
  - Collaboration sync is out of scope.

**What we haven't decided:**

1. **Where the button goes.** Options:
   - Pinned at the bottom of the font picker dropdown, always visible.
   - At the top of the "Custom" section.
   - An icon button next to the picker trigger in the properties panel.
2. **What happens after clicking.** One option: the file dialog opens first, then a small dialog asks for the font's name (defaulting to the file name) and shows the license checkbox. Another: one dialog that holds the file chooser, name field and checkbox together.
3. **What happens after upload.** Should the new font be applied to the selected text straight away (the issue's scenario says yes)? And when no text is selected, should it become the default font for new text?
4. **Limits and errors.** How large a file is allowed (I'd suggest about 5 MB)? What message appears for a corrupt file or a wrong file type? What if the same font is uploaded twice? With the content-based IDs I suggested, a duplicate would just select the font that's already there.
5. **Removing fonts.** A trash icon on each custom font row in the picker, or somewhere else? Should it ask for confirmation when text in the scene uses the font?
6. **Keyboard access.** Should the button work with the picker's existing arrow-key navigation and search?

My recommendation:

- Pin the button at the bottom of the picker dropdown, outside the search filtering.
- File dialog first, then one small dialog with the name field and the license checkbox.
- Apply the font to the selected text, or make it the default for new text when nothing is selected.
- 5 MB limit, inline error messages, and duplicates simply select the existing font.
- A trash icon on custom font rows, with a confirmation when the font is in use.
- Keyboard access through the picker's existing navigation.

Do you want to settle these now, or as we reach steps 3–5? Step 2, the registry, doesn't depend on any of them.

```typescript
import { FONT_FAMILY } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { Fonts } from "./Fonts";

const DATA_URL = "data:font/woff2;base64,d09GMgABAAAAAA==";

describe("Fonts custom font registry (#140)", () => {
  const deleteSpy = vi.fn();

  beforeAll(() => {
    // the jsdom `document.fonts` mock from setupTests.ts has no `delete`
    Object.assign(window.document.fonts, { delete: deleteSpy });
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    // the registry is static, so make sure no test leaks into another
    for (const id of [2000, 2007, 2042]) {
      Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(id);
    }
    Fonts.loadedFontsCache.clear();
    deleteSpy.mockClear();
  });

  describe("registerCustomFont()", () => {
    it("adds the font under its id, labelled with the user-facing name", () => {
      expect(
        Fonts.registerCustomFont({
          id: 2007,
          name: "My Font",
          dataURL: DATA_URL,
        }),
      ).toBe(true);

      const registered = Fonts.registered.get(2007);
      expect(registered?.metadata.custom).toEqual({ name: "My Font" });
      expect(registered?.fontFaces).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(registered?.fontFaces[0].fontFace.family).toBe(
        "ExcalidrawCustomFont-2007",
      );
      expect(registered?.fontFaces[0].urls).toEqual([DATA_URL]);
    });

    it("uses Excalifont metrics for custom fonts", () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont({ id: 2007, name: "A", dataURL: DATA_URL });

      expect(Fonts.registered.get(2007)?.metadata.metrics).toEqual({
        unitsPerEm: 1000,
        ascender: 886,
        descender: -374,
        lineHeight: 1.25,
      });
    });

    it("is a no-op when the id is already registered", () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont({ id: 2007, name: "First", dataURL: DATA_URL });

      expect(
        Fonts.registerCustomFont({
          id: 2007,
          name: "Second",
          dataURL: "data:font/woff2;base64,AAAA",
        }),
      ).toBe(false);
      expect(Fonts.registered.get(2007)?.metadata.custom).toEqual({
        name: "First",
      });
    });

    it("accepts the first id of the custom range", () => {
      expect(
        Fonts.registerCustomFont({ id: 2000, name: "A", dataURL: DATA_URL }),
      ).toBe(true);
    });

    it("rejects ids outside the custom range without touching built-ins", () => {
      expect(() =>
        Fonts.registerCustomFont({
          id: FONT_FAMILY.Excalifont,
          name: "Hijack",
          dataURL: DATA_URL,
        }),
      ).toThrow();
      expect(() =>
        Fonts.registerCustomFont({ id: 1999, name: "A", dataURL: DATA_URL }),
      ).toThrow();

      expect(Fonts.registered.has(1999)).toBe(false);
      expect(
        Fonts.registered.get(FONT_FAMILY.Excalifont)?.metadata.custom,
      ).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });

  describe("unregisterCustomFont()", () => {
    it("removes the font from the registry and from document.fonts", () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont({ id: 2007, name: "A", dataURL: DATA_URL });
      const { fontFace } = Fonts.registered.get(2007)!.fontFaces[0];

      expect(Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(2007)).toBe(true);

      expect(Fonts.registered.has(2007)).toBe(false);
      expect(deleteSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(deleteSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(fontFace);
    });

    it("clears only that font's entries from the loaded fonts cache", () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont({ id: 2007, name: "A", dataURL: DATA_URL });
      Fonts.registerCustomFont({ id: 2042, name: "B", dataURL: DATA_URL });
      Fonts.loadedFontsCache.add(
        "ExcalidrawCustomFont-2007-normal-400-U+0-10FFFF",
      );
      Fonts.loadedFontsCache.add(
        "ExcalidrawCustomFont-2042-normal-400-U+0-10FFFF",
      );
      Fonts.loadedFontsCache.add("Excalifont-normal-400-U+0-10FFFF");

      Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(2007);

      expect(Array.from(Fonts.loadedFontsCache).sort()).toEqual([
        "Excalifont-normal-400-U+0-10FFFF",
        "ExcalidrawCustomFont-2042-normal-400-U+0-10FFFF",
      ]);
    });

    it("returns false for an id that isn't registered", () => {
      expect(Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(2007)).toBe(false);
      expect(deleteSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("refuses to unregister built-in fonts", () => {
      expect(Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(FONT_FAMILY.Excalifont)).toBe(false);
      expect(Fonts.registered.has(FONT_FAMILY.Excalifont)).toBe(true);
      expect(deleteSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
});
```

```text
export const generateIdFromFile = async (file: File): Promise<FileId> => {
  try {
    const hashBuffer = await window.crypto.subtle.digest(
      "SHA-1",
      await blobToArrayBuffer(file),
    );
    return bytesToHexString(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer)) as FileId;
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error(error);
    // length 40 to align with the HEX length of SHA-1 (which is 160 bit)
    return nanoid(40) as FileId;
  }
};

/** async. For sync variant, use getDataURL_sync */
export const getDataURL = async (file: Blob | File): Promise<DataURL> => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      const dataURL = reader.result as DataURL;
      resolve(dataURL);
    };
    reader.onerror = (error) => reject(error);
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
};

export const getDataURL_sync = (
  data: string | Uint8Array | ArrayBuffer,

};

export const blobToArrayBuffer = (blob: Blob): Promise<ArrayBuffer> => {
  if ("arrayBuffer" in blob) {
    return blob.arrayBuffer();
  }
  // Safari
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      if (!event.target?.result) {
        return reject(new Error("Couldn't convert blob to ArrayBuffer"));
      }
      resolve(event.target.result as ArrayBuffer);
    };
    reader.readAsArrayBuffer(blob);
  });
};
```

```typescript
import {
  CUSTOM_FONT_FAMILY_ID_START,
  CUSTOM_FONT_MIME_TYPES,
} from "@excalidraw/common";

import { blobToArrayBuffer, getDataURL, getNameWithoutExtension } from "./blob";

import type { CustomFontData } from "../types";
import type { ValueOf } from "@excalidraw/common/utility-types";

/** Largest font file users can upload (#140). */
export const CUSTOM_FONT_MAX_SIZE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

/** Name used when the file name is empty after stripping the extension. */
export const CUSTOM_FONT_DEFAULT_NAME = "Custom font";

// first 4 bytes of every WOFF / WOFF2 file
// https://www.w3.org/TR/WOFF/#WOFFHeader, https://www.w3.org/TR/WOFF2/#woff20Header
const WOFF_SIGNATURE = 0x774f4646; // "wOFF"
const WOFF2_SIGNATURE = 0x774f4632; // "wOF2"

export type CustomFontErrorCode =
  | "tooLarge"
  | "unsupportedType"
  | "invalidFont";

export class CustomFontError extends Error {
  public readonly code: CustomFontErrorCode;

  constructor(code: CustomFontErrorCode, message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "CustomFontError";
    this.code = code;
  }
}

/**
 * Font data read from an uploaded file, before the user has named it and
 * acknowledged its license in the upload dialog.
 */
export type CustomFontCandidate = Omit<CustomFontData, "licenseAcknowledged">;

/**
 * Detects WOFF / WOFF2 from the file's signature rather than its extension or
 * reported MIME type, which browsers fill in inconsistently for fonts.
 */
export const detectCustomFontMimeType = (
  bytes: Uint8Array,
): ValueOf<typeof CUSTOM_FONT_MIME_TYPES> | null => {
  if (bytes.length < 4) {
    return null;
  }

  const signature = new DataView(
    bytes.buffer,
    bytes.byteOffset,
    bytes.byteLength,
  ).getUint32(0);

  switch (signature) {
    case WOFF_SIGNATURE:
      return CUSTOM_FONT_MIME_TYPES.woff;
    case WOFF2_SIGNATURE:
      return CUSTOM_FONT_MIME_TYPES.woff2;
    default:
      return null;
  }
};

/**
 * Derives the `fontFamily` id from the font's bytes (djb2 hash, unsigned
 * 32-bit), so the same font gets the same id in every scene.
 */
export const getCustomFontFamilyId = (bytes: Uint8Array): number => {
  let hash = 5381;
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
    hash = ((hash << 5) + hash + bytes[i]) | 0;
  }
  return CUSTOM_FONT_FAMILY_ID_START + (hash >>> 0);
};

/**
 * Reads and validates an uploaded font file.
 *
 * @throws {CustomFontError} `tooLarge` above {@link CUSTOM_FONT_MAX_SIZE_BYTES},
 * `unsupportedType` when it isn't WOFF/WOFF2, `invalidFont` when the browser
 * can't load it.
 */
export const loadCustomFontFile = async (
  file: File,
): Promise<CustomFontCandidate> => {
  if (file.size > CUSTOM_FONT_MAX_SIZE_BYTES) {
    throw new CustomFontError(
      "tooLarge",
      `Font file is ${file.size} bytes, the limit is ${CUSTOM_FONT_MAX_SIZE_BYTES}`,
    );
  }

  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await blobToArrayBuffer(file));

  const mimeType = detectCustomFontMimeType(bytes);
  if (!mimeType) {
    throw new CustomFontError(
      "unsupportedType",
      "Only WOFF and WOFF2 font files are supported",
    );
  }

  try {
    // let the browser parse it, so corrupt files are rejected up front
    await new FontFace("excalidraw-custom-font-validation", bytes).load();
  } catch (error) {
    throw new CustomFontError(
      "invalidFont",
      `Font file couldn't be loaded: ${error}`,
    );
  }

  return {
    id: getCustomFontFamilyId(bytes),
    name: getNameWithoutExtension(file.name).trim() || CUSTOM_FONT_DEFAULT_NAME,
    mimeType,
    // built from the detected type, as `file.type` is often empty for fonts
    dataURL: await getDataURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: mimeType })),
    created: Date.now(),
  };
};
```

```typescript
const WOFF_BYTES = new Uint8Array([0x77, 0x4f, 0x46, 0x46, 0, 1, 0, 0]);
// TrueType (0x00010000) and OpenType ("OTTO") signatures

const OTF_BYTES = new Uint8Array([0x4f, 0x54, 0x54, 0x4f, 0, 1, 0, 0]);

    it("detects WOFF2 and WOFF from the file signature", () => {
      expect(detectCustomFontMimeType(WOFF2_BYTES)).toBe("font/woff2");
      expect(detectCustomFontMimeType(WOFF_BYTES)).toBe("font/woff");
    });

    it("rejects TTF, OTF and other files", () => {
      expect(detectCustomFontMimeType(TTF_BYTES)).toBeNull();
      expect(detectCustomFontMimeType(OTF_BYTES)).toBeNull();
      expect(
        detectCustomFontMimeType(new TextEncoder().encode("hello world")),
      ).toBeNull();
    });

    it("rejects inputs shorter than the 4-byte signature", () => {
      expect(detectCustomFontMimeType(new Uint8Array([]))).toBeNull();
      expect(

      expect(id).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2000 + 0xffffffff);
    });
  });

  describe("loadCustomFontFile()", () => {
    it("returns the font data for a valid WOFF2 file", async () => {
      vi.spyOn(Date, "now").mockReturnValue(1234);

      const font = await loadCustomFontFile(
        makeFile(WOFF2_BYTES, "My Font.woff2"),
      );

      expect(font).toEqual({
        id: expect.any(Number),
        name: "My Font",
        mimeType: "font/woff2",
        dataURL: `data:font/woff2;base64,${toBase64(WOFF2_BYTES)}`,
        created: 1234,
      });
      expect(isCustomFontFamily(font.id)).toBe(true);
    });

    it("accepts WOFF files", async () => {
      const font = await loadCustomFontFile(makeFile(WOFF_BYTES, "a.woff"));

      expect(font.mimeType).toBe("font/woff");
      expect(font.dataURL).toBe(
        `data:font/woff;base64,${toBase64(WOFF_BYTES)}`,
      );
    });

    it("trusts the file signature over the extension and reported type", async () => {
      const font = await loadCustomFontFile(
        makeFile(WOFF2_BYTES, "renamed.txt", "text/plain"),
      );

      expect(font.mimeType).toBe("font/woff2");
    });

    it("gives the same id to the same font uploaded under different names", async () => {
      const a = await loadCustomFontFile(makeFile(WOFF2_BYTES, "a.woff2"));
      const b = await loadCustomFontFile(makeFile(WOFF2_BYTES, "b.woff2"));

      expect(a.id).toBe(b.id);
    });

    it("trims the name and falls back to a default when it's empty", async () => {
      const spaced = await loadCustomFontFile(
        makeFile(WOFF2_BYTES, "  Spaced Out  .woff2"),
      );
      const empty = await loadCustomFontFile(makeFile(WOFF2_BYTES, ".woff2"));

      expect(spaced.name).toBe("Spaced Out");
      expect(empty.name).toBe("Custom font");
    });

    it("accepts a file exactly at the 5 MB limit", async () => {
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(5 * 1024 * 1024);
      bytes.set(WOFF2_BYTES);

      await expect(
        loadCustomFontFile(makeFile(bytes, "big.woff2")),
      ).resolves.toMatchObject({ mimeType: "font/woff2" });
    });

    it("rejects files over 5 MB with a tooLarge error", async () => {
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(5 * 1024 * 1024 + 1);
      bytes.set(WOFF2_BYTES);

      const error = await loadCustomFontFile(makeFile(bytes, "huge.woff2"))
        .then(() => null)
        .catch((e) => e);

      expect(CUSTOM_FONT_MAX_SIZE_BYTES).toBe(5 * 1024 * 1024);
      expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(CustomFontError);
      expect(error.code).toBe("tooLarge");
    });

    it("rejects TTF and OTF files with an unsupportedType error", async () => {
      for (const [bytes, name] of [
        [TTF_BYTES, "font.ttf"],
        [OTF_BYTES, "font.otf"],
      ] as const) {
        await expect(
          loadCustomFontFile(makeFile(bytes, name)),
        ).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "unsupportedType" });
      }
    });

    it("rejects files the browser can't load with an invalidFont error", async () => {
      const loadSpy = vi
        .spyOn(window.FontFace.prototype, "load")
        .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error("OTS parsing error"));

      await expect(
        loadCustomFontFile(makeFile(WOFF2_BYTES, "corrupt.woff2")),
      ).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "invalidFont" });
      expect(loadSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    it("doesn't try to parse files that fail the size or type checks", async () => {
      const loadSpy = vi.spyOn(window.FontFace.prototype, "load");

      await expect(
        loadCustomFontFile(makeFile(TTF_BYTES, "font.ttf")),
      ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(CustomFontError);
      expect(loadSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
});
```

I've recorded your remove and upload decisions in memory and written step 3. It's the file-handling logic only, with no UI yet. The 17 new tests pass, and so do all 32 custom-font tests across steps 1–3. Typecheck and lint are clean. Nothing is staged.

**What's in the new module, [customFonts.ts](packages/excalidraw/data/customFonts.ts):**

- **`loadCustomFontFile(file)`** reads an uploaded file, checks it, and returns the font data for the upload dialog:
  1. Files over 5 MB are rejected (`tooLarge`).
  2. The first 4 bytes must be the WOFF (`wOFF`) or WOFF2 (`wOF2`) signature, otherwise it's rejected (`unsupportedType`). The extension and the browser's reported file type are ignored, because browsers fill those in unreliably for fonts. TTF and OTF are rejected this way.
  3. The browser then tries to load the font, so corrupt files are rejected before they're added (`invalidFont`).
  4. On success it returns the ID, a name (the file name without its extension, or "Custom font" if that's empty), the file type, the font as a data URL, and a timestamp.
- **The ID comes from the file's contents,** so the same font gets the same ID in every scene, and a duplicate upload maps to the existing font.
- **There's no license field yet.** The returned data deliberately leaves out `licenseAcknowledged`, so step 4's dialog has to set it explicitly.
- **Errors carry a code** (`tooLarge`, `unsupportedType` or `invalidFont`), so step 4 can show a translated message for each.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| A: only WOFF/WOFF2 allowed (your decision) | `detectCustomFontMimeType()` tests, TTF/OTF rejection | Unit | Standard file signatures: TrueType starts with `00 01 00 00`, OpenType with `OTTO`. |
| A: 5 MB limit (your decision) | Exactly 5 MB accepted, 5 MB + 1 byte rejected | Unit (boundary) | Your 5 MB decision. |

```ps1
function Mutate($file, $from, $to, $test = "packages/common/src/customFonts.test.ts") {
  Write-Host ""
  Write-Host "=== MUTANT ===================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
  Write-Host "File : $file"
  Write-Host "Tests: $test"
  Write-Host "From : $from" -ForegroundColor Red
  Write-Host "To   : $to" -ForegroundColor Green

  $path = (Resolve-Path $file).Path
  $text = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($path)
  $count = ([regex]::Matches($text, [regex]::Escape($from))).Count
  if ($count -eq 0) { Write-Host "SKIPPED: pattern not found in file" -ForegroundColor Yellow; return }
  Write-Host "Found $count occurrence(s), replacing all"

  $report = Join-Path $env:TEMP "mutate-vitest-report.json"
  if (Test-Path $report) { Remove-Item $report -Force }

  Copy-Item $path "$path.bak" -Force
  try {
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $text.Replace($from, $to))
    Write-Host "Mutation applied, running tests..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    yarn -s vitest run $test --reporter=json --outputFile="$report" 2>&1 | Out-Null

    if (-not (Test-Path $report)) {
      Write-Host "RESULT: ERROR (no test report, the mutant probably broke compilation, which counts as KILLED)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
      return
    }

    $json = Get-Content $report -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
    $all = @($json.testResults | ForEach-Object { $_.assertionResults })
    $failed = @($all | Where-Object { $_.status -eq "failed" })
    Write-Host "Ran $($all.Count) tests: $($failed.Count) failed, $($all.Count - $failed.Count) passed"

    if ($failed.Count -gt 0) {
      Write-Host "Failing tests:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
      $i = 1
      foreach ($t in $failed) {
        Write-Host "  $i. $($t.fullName)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        $msg = ($t.failureMessages | Select-Object -First 1) -split "`n" | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($msg) { Write-Host "     $msg" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        $i++
      }
      Write-Host "RESULT: KILLED (a test failed, which is what we want)" -ForegroundColor Green
    } else {
      Write-Host "RESULT: SURVIVED (all tests still pass, so no test catches this change)" -ForegroundColor Red
    }
  } finally {
    Move-Item "$path.bak" $path -Force
    Write-Host "Original file restored" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
  }
}
```

```text
import { useState } from "react";

import { KEYS, normalizeLink } from "@excalidraw/common";

import type { TextHyperlink } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import { t } from "../i18n";

import { CheckboxItem } from "./CheckboxItem";
import { Dialog } from "./Dialog";
import DialogActionButton from "./DialogActionButton";
import { TextField } from "./TextField";

import "./TextHyperlinkDialog.scss";

import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";

export type TextHyperlinkDialogResult = {
  displayText: string;
  url: string;
  color: TextHyperlink["color"];
};

/**
 * Dialog for inserting a hyperlink into the text being edited, opened via
 * Ctrl/Cmd+K from the text editor.
 */
export const TextHyperlinkDialog = ({
  initialDisplayText,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: {
  initialDisplayText: string;
  onConfirm: (result: TextHyperlinkDialogResult) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) => {
  const [displayText, setDisplayText] = useState(initialDisplayText);
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  const [useTextColor, setUseTextColor] = useState(false);

  const normalizedUrl = normalizeLink(url);

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    if (!normalizedUrl) {
      return;
    }
    onConfirm({
      // fall back to the URL itself when no text was provided
      displayText: displayText || url.trim(),
      url: normalizedUrl,
      color: useTextColor ? "inherit" : "link",
    });
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (event.key === KEYS.ENTER) {
      event.preventDefault();
      handleConfirm();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog
      size="small"
      onCloseRequest={onCancel}
      title={t("textHyperlinkDialog.title")}
      className="TextHyperlinkDialog"
    >
      <div className="TextHyperlinkDialog__fields">
        <TextField
          label={t("textHyperlinkDialog.displayText")}
          placeholder={t("textHyperlinkDialog.displayTextPlaceholder")}
          value={displayText}
          onChange={setDisplayText}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          fullWidth
        />
        <TextField
          label={t("textHyperlinkDialog.url")}
          placeholder="https://"
          value={url}
          onChange={setUrl}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          fullWidth
        />
        <CheckboxItem checked={useTextColor} onChange={setUseTextColor}>
          {t("textHyperlinkDialog.useTextColor")}
        </CheckboxItem>
      </div>
      <div className="TextHyperlinkDialog__actions">
        <DialogActionButton label={t("buttons.cancel")} onClick={onCancel} />
        <DialogActionButton
          label={t("buttons.confirm")}
          onClick={handleConfirm}
          actionType="primary"
          disabled={!normalizedUrl}
        />
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
};

  children,
  actionType,
  type = "button",
  isLoading,
  ...rest
}: DialogActionButtonProps & React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
  const cs = actionType ? `Dialog__action-button--${actionType}` : "";

  return (
    <button
      className={clsx("Dialog__action-button", cs, className)}
      type={type}
      aria-label={label}
      onClick={onClick}
      {...rest}
    >
      {children && (
        <div style={isLoading ? { visibility: "hidden" } : {}}>{children}</div>
      )}
      <div style={isLoading ? { visibility: "hidden" } : {}}>{label}</div>
      {isLoading && (
        <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0 }}>
          <Spinner />
        </div>
      )}
    </button>
  );
};

export default DialogActionButton;
```

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { KEYS } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { CustomFontError, loadCustomFontFile } from "../data/customFonts";
import { t } from "../i18n";

import { CheckboxItem } from "./CheckboxItem";
import { Dialog } from "./Dialog";
import DialogActionButton from "./DialogActionButton";
import { TextField } from "./TextField";

import "./CustomFontUploadDialog.scss";

import type { CustomFontCandidate } from "../data/customFonts";
import type { CustomFontErrorCode } from "../data/customFonts";
import type { CustomFontData } from "../types";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";

type LoadState =
  | { status: "loading" }
  | { status: "ready"; candidate: CustomFontCandidate }
  | { status: "error"; code: CustomFontErrorCode };

/**
 * Dialog shown after the user picks a font file (#140): validates the file,
 * lets the user name the font and requires them to acknowledge its license
 * before it can be added.
 */
export const CustomFontUploadDialog = ({
  file,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: {
  file: File;
  onConfirm: (font: CustomFontData) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) => {
  const [state, setState] = useState<LoadState>({ status: "loading" });
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [licenseAcknowledged, setLicenseAcknowledged] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    setState({ status: "loading" });
    loadCustomFontFile(file)
      .then((candidate) => {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setState({ status: "ready", candidate });
          setName(candidate.name);
        }
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setState({
            status: "error",
            code: error instanceof CustomFontError ? error.code : "invalidFont",
          });
        }
      });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [file]);

  const trimmedName = name.trim();
  const canConfirm =
    state.status === "ready" && licenseAcknowledged && trimmedName !== "";

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    if (!canConfirm) {
      return;
    }
    onConfirm({
      ...state.candidate,
      name: trimmedName,
      licenseAcknowledged: true,
    });
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (event.key === KEYS.ENTER) {
      event.preventDefault();
      handleConfirm();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog
      size="small"
      onCloseRequest={onCancel}
      title={t("customFontDialog.title")}
      className="CustomFontUploadDialog"
    >
      <div className="CustomFontUploadDialog__fields">
        {state.status === "loading" && (
          <p className="CustomFontUploadDialog__status">
            {t("customFontDialog.loading")}
          </p>
        )}

        {state.status === "error" && (
          <p className="CustomFontUploadDialog__error" role="alert">
            {t(`customFontDialog.errors.${state.code}`)}
          </p>
        )}

        {state.status === "ready" && (
          <>
            <TextField
              label={t("customFontDialog.name")}
              placeholder={t("customFontDialog.namePlaceholder")}
              value={name}
              onChange={setName}
              onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
              selectOnRender
              fullWidth
            />
            <CheckboxItem
              checked={licenseAcknowledged}
              onChange={setLicenseAcknowledged}
            >
              {t("customFontDialog.license")}
            </CheckboxItem>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="CustomFontUploadDialog__actions">
        <DialogActionButton label={t("buttons.cancel")} onClick={onCancel} />
        {state.status !== "error" && (
          <DialogActionButton
            label={t("customFontDialog.add")}
            onClick={handleConfirm}
            actionType="primary"
            disabled={!canConfirm}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
};
```

```typescript
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import React from "react";

import { CustomFontError, loadCustomFontFile } from "../data/customFonts";

import { CustomFontUploadDialog } from "./CustomFontUploadDialog";

import type { CustomFontCandidate } from "../data/customFonts";

// the real Dialog needs the whole editor context (container, app state, jotai),
// these tests only cover this dialog's own logic
vi.mock("./Dialog", () => ({
  Dialog: ({
    title,
    children,
    onCloseRequest,
  }: {
    title: React.ReactNode;
    children: React.ReactNode;
    onCloseRequest: () => void;
  }) => (
    <div role="dialog">
      <h2>{title}</h2>
      <button onClick={onCloseRequest}>close</button>
      {children}
    </div>
  ),
}));

vi.mock("../data/customFonts", async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<typeof import("../data/customFonts")>()),
  loadCustomFontFile: vi.fn(),
}));

const loadMock = vi.mocked(loadCustomFontFile);

const CANDIDATE: CustomFontCandidate = {
  id: 2007,
  name: "My Font",
  mimeType: "font/woff2",
  dataURL: "data:font/woff2;base64,d09GMg==" as CustomFontCandidate["dataURL"],
  created: 1234,
};

const FILE = new File(["wOF2"], "My Font.woff2");

const renderDialog = async () => {
  const onConfirm = vi.fn();
  const onCancel = vi.fn();

  await act(async () => {
    render(
      <CustomFontUploadDialog
        file={FILE}
        onConfirm={onConfirm}
        onCancel={onCancel}
      />,
    );
  });

  return { onConfirm, onCancel };
};

const nameInput = () => screen.getByRole("textbox") as HTMLInputElement;
const licenseCheckbox = () => screen.getByRole("checkbox");
const addButton = () =>
  screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Add font" }) as HTMLButtonElement;
const cancelButton = () => screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" });

describe("<CustomFontUploadDialog /> (#140)", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    loadMock.mockReset();
  });

  describe("valid font file", () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
      loadMock.mockResolvedValue(CANDIDATE);
    });

    it("reads the chosen file", async () => {
      await renderDialog();

      expect(loadMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(loadMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith(FILE);
    });

    it("shows the title and pre-fills the name from the file", async () => {
      await renderDialog();

      expect(screen.getByText("Add custom font")).not.toBeNull();
      expect(nameInput().value).toBe("My Font");
    });

    it("keeps Add disabled until the license box is ticked", async () => {
      await renderDialog();

      expect(licenseCheckbox().getAttribute("aria-checked")).toBe("false");
      expect(addButton().disabled).toBe(true);

      fireEvent.click(licenseCheckbox());

      expect(licenseCheckbox().getAttribute("aria-checked")).toBe("true");
      expect(addButton().disabled).toBe(false);
    });

    it("disables Add again if the license box is unticked", async () => {
      await renderDialog();

      fireEvent.click(licenseCheckbox());
      fireEvent.click(licenseCheckbox());

      expect(addButton().disabled).toBe(true);
    });

    it("adds the font with the acknowledged license", async () => {
      const { onConfirm } = await renderDialog();

      fireEvent.click(licenseCheckbox());
      fireEvent.click(addButton());

      expect(onConfirm).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(onConfirm).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        id: 2007,
        name: "My Font",
        mimeType: "font/woff2",
        dataURL: "data:font/woff2;base64,d09GMg==",
        created: 1234,
        licenseAcknowledged: true,
      });
    });

    it("uses the edited name, trimmed", async () => {
      const { onConfirm } = await renderDialog();

      fireEvent.change(nameInput(), { target: { value: "  Renamed  " } });
      fireEvent.click(licenseCheckbox());
      fireEvent.click(addButton());

      expect(onConfirm.mock.calls[0][0].name).toBe("Renamed");
    });

    it("disables Add when the name is blank", async () => {
      const { onConfirm } = await renderDialog();

      fireEvent.click(licenseCheckbox());
      fireEvent.change(nameInput(), { target: { value: "   " } });

      expect(addButton().disabled).toBe(true);
      fireEvent.click(addButton());
      expect(onConfirm).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("confirms with Enter only once the license is acknowledged", async () => {
      const { onConfirm } = await renderDialog();

      fireEvent.keyDown(nameInput(), { key: "Enter" });
      expect(onConfirm).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

      fireEvent.click(licenseCheckbox());
      fireEvent.keyDown(nameInput(), { key: "Enter" });
      expect(onConfirm).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    it("cancels without adding the font", async () => {
      const { onConfirm, onCancel } = await renderDialog();

      fireEvent.click(cancelButton());

      expect(onCancel).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(onConfirm).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("cancels when the dialog is closed", async () => {
      const { onCancel } = await renderDialog();

      fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "close" }));

      expect(onCancel).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });
  });

  describe("while reading the file", () => {
    it("shows a loading message and a disabled Add button", async () => {
      loadMock.mockReturnValue(new Promise(() => {}));

      await renderDialog();

      expect(screen.getByText("Reading font file…")).not.toBeNull();
      expect(screen.queryByRole("textbox")).toBeNull();
      expect(addButton().disabled).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe("invalid font file", () => {
    it.each([
      ["tooLarge", "This font file is larger than 5 MB."],
      ["unsupportedType", "Only WOFF and WOFF2 font files are supported."],
      [
        "invalidFont",
        "This file couldn't be read as a font. It may be damaged.",
      ],
    ] as const)("shows the %s error message", async (code, message) => {
      loadMock.mockRejectedValue(new CustomFontError(code, "test"));

      await renderDialog();

      expect(screen.getByRole("alert").textContent).toBe(message);
    });

    it("treats unexpected errors as an unreadable font", async () => {
      loadMock.mockRejectedValue(new Error("something else"));

      await renderDialog();

      expect(screen.getByRole("alert").textContent).toBe(
        "This file couldn't be read as a font. It may be damaged.",
      );
    });

    it("offers only Cancel, with no name field or license box", async () => {
      loadMock.mockRejectedValue(new CustomFontError("tooLarge", "test"));

      const { onCancel } = await renderDialog();

      expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: "Add font" })).toBeNull();
      expect(screen.queryByRole("textbox")).toBeNull();
      expect(screen.queryByRole("checkbox")).toBeNull();

      fireEvent.click(cancelButton());
      expect(onCancel).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });
  });
});
```

Step 4 is done: the upload dialog component, not yet connected to the picker. Step 3 is staged. Step 4's files are new and unstaged.

**What's new:**

- **[CustomFontUploadDialog.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/CustomFontUploadDialog.tsx):** given the file the user picked, the dialog:
  1. Shows "Reading font file…" while it checks the file with step 3's `loadCustomFontFile`.
  2. If the file is fine, shows a **Font name** field (pre-filled from the file name, text selected) and the **license checkbox**: "I have the right to use this font, including embedding it in drawings I export or share."
  3. Keeps **Add font** disabled until the box is ticked and the name isn't blank. Enter in the name field adds the font only under the same conditions.
  4. If the file is rejected, shows the error message and only a Cancel button.
- **Styles** in `CustomFontUploadDialog.scss`, matching the hyperlink dialog.
- **English text** in `en.json` under a new `customFontDialog` section: the dialog wording plus three error messages ("larger than 5 MB", "Only WOFF and WOFF2…", "couldn't be read as a font").

9. [accepts WOFF files](packages/excalidraw/data/customFonts.test.ts#L103)
10. [trusts the file signature over the extension and reported type](packages/excalidraw/data/customFonts.test.ts#L112)
11. [same id for the same font under different names](packages/excalidraw/data/customFonts.test.ts#L120)
12. [trims the name and falls back to a default](packages/excalidraw/data/customFonts.test.ts#L127)
13. [accepts a file exactly at the 5 MB limit](packages/excalidraw/data/customFonts.test.ts#L137)
14. [rejects files over 5 MB (tooLarge)](packages/excalidraw/data/customFonts.test.ts#L146)
15. [rejects TTF and OTF (unsupportedType)](packages/excalidraw/data/customFonts.test.ts#L159)
16. [rejects files the browser can't load (invalidFont)](packages/excalidraw/data/customFonts.test.ts#L170)
17. [doesn't parse files that fail the size or type checks](packages/excalidraw/data/customFonts.test.ts#L181)

### Step 2: runtime registry, [Fonts.test.ts](packages/excalidraw/fonts/Fonts.test.ts)

**`registerCustomFont()`:**

1. [adds the font under its id, labelled with the user-facing name](packages/excalidraw/fonts/Fonts.test.ts#L25)
2. [uses Excalifont metrics for custom fonts](packages/excalidraw/fonts/Fonts.test.ts#L43)
3. [is a no-op when the id is already registered](packages/excalidraw/fonts/Fonts.test.ts#L54)
4. [accepts the first id of the custom range](packages/excalidraw/fonts/Fonts.test.ts#L69)
5. [rejects ids outside the custom range](packages/excalidraw/fonts/Fonts.test.ts#L75)

**`unregisterCustomFont()`:**

6. [removes the font from the registry and document.fonts](packages/excalidraw/fonts/Fonts.test.ts#L95)
7. [clears only that font's cache entries](packages/excalidraw/fonts/Fonts.test.ts#L106)
8. [returns false for an unregistered id](packages/excalidraw/fonts/Fonts.test.ts#L127)
9. [refuses to unregister built-in fonts](packages/excalidraw/fonts/Fonts.test.ts#L132)

### Step 1: ID range and font strings, [customFonts.test.ts](packages/common/src/customFonts.test.ts)

**`isCustomFontFamily()`:**

1. [rejects every built-in and fallback font id](packages/common/src/customFonts.test.ts#L12)
2. [accepts ids from the custom range start upwards](packages/common/src/customFonts.test.ts#L21)
3. [rejects non-integer and non-finite values](packages/common/src/customFonts.test.ts#L28)

**`getFontFamilyString()`:**

4. [maps custom ids to their CSS name plus fallbacks](packages/common/src/customFonts.test.ts#L36)
5. [leaves built-in font strings unchanged](packages/common/src/customFonts.test.ts#L42)
6. [includes the custom family in getFontString()](packages/common/src/customFonts.test.ts#L48)


```text
import { Popover } from "radix-ui";
import clsx from "clsx";
import React, { useCallback, useMemo } from "react";

import { FONT_FAMILY } from "@excalidraw/common";

import type { FontFamilyValues } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import { t } from "../../i18n";
import { RadioSelection } from "../RadioSelection";
import { ButtonSeparator } from "../ButtonSeparator";
import {
  FontFamilyCodeIcon,
  FontFamilyNormalIcon,
  FreedrawIcon,
} from "../icons";

import { FontPickerList } from "./FontPickerList";
import { FontPickerTrigger } from "./FontPickerTrigger";

import "./FontPicker.scss";

export const DEFAULT_FONTS = [
  {
    value: FONT_FAMILY.Excalifont,
    icon: FreedrawIcon,
    text: t("labels.handDrawn"),
    testId: "font-family-hand-drawn",
  },
  {
    value: FONT_FAMILY.Nunito,
    icon: FontFamilyNormalIcon,
    text: t("labels.normal"),
    testId: "font-family-normal",
  },
  {
    value: FONT_FAMILY["Comic Shanns"],
    icon: FontFamilyCodeIcon,
    text: t("labels.code"),
    testId: "font-family-code",
  },
];

const defaultFontFamilies = new Set(DEFAULT_FONTS.map((x) => x.value));

export const isDefaultFont = (fontFamily: number | null) => {
  if (!fontFamily) {
    return false;
  }

  return defaultFontFamilies.has(fontFamily);
};

interface FontPickerProps {
  isOpened: boolean;
  selectedFontFamily: FontFamilyValues | null;
  hoveredFontFamily: FontFamilyValues | null;
  onSelect: (fontFamily: FontFamilyValues) => void;
  onHover: (fontFamily: FontFamilyValues) => void;
  onLeave: () => void;
  onPopupChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  compactMode?: boolean;
}

export const FontPicker = React.memo(
  ({
    isOpened,
    selectedFontFamily,
    hoveredFontFamily,
    onSelect,
    onHover,
    onLeave,
    onPopupChange,
    compactMode = false,
  }: FontPickerProps) => {
    const defaultFonts = useMemo(() => DEFAULT_FONTS, []);
    const onSelectCallback = useCallback(
      (value: number | false) => {
        if (value) {
          onSelect(value);
        }
      },
      [onSelect],
    );

    return (
      <div
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        className={clsx("FontPicker__container", {
          "FontPicker__container--compact": compactMode,
        })}
      >
        {!compactMode && (
          <div className="buttonList">
            <RadioSelection<FontFamilyValues | false>
              type="button"
              options={defaultFonts}
              value={selectedFontFamily}
              onClick={onSelectCallback}
            />
          </div>
        )}
        {!compactMode && <ButtonSeparator />}
        <Popover.Root open={isOpened} onOpenChange={onPopupChange}>
          <FontPickerTrigger
            selectedFontFamily={selectedFontFamily}
            isOpened={isOpened}
            compactMode={compactMode}
          />
          {isOpened && (
            <FontPickerList
              selectedFontFamily={selectedFontFamily}
              hoveredFontFamily={hoveredFontFamily}
              onSelect={onSelectCallback}
              onHover={onHover}
              onLeave={onLeave}
              onOpen={() => onPopupChange(true)}
              onClose={() => onPopupChange(false)}
            />
          )}
        </Popover.Root>
      </div>
    );
  },
  (prev, next) =>
    prev.isOpened === next.isOpened &&
    prev.selectedFontFamily === next.selectedFontFamily &&
    prev.hoveredFontFamily === next.hoveredFontFamily,
);
```

```text
export const normalizeFile = async (file: File) => {
  // to prevent double normalization (perf optim)
  if ((file as any)[normalizedFileSymbol]) {
    return file;
  }

  if (file?.name?.endsWith(".excalidrawlib")) {
    file = createFile(file, MIME_TYPES.excalidrawlib, file.name);
  } else if (file?.name?.endsWith(".excalidraw")) {
    file = createFile(file, MIME_TYPES.excalidraw, file.name);
  } else if (!file.type || file.type?.startsWith("image/")) {
    // when the file is an image, make sure the extension corresponds to the
    // actual mimeType (this is an edge case, but happens - especially
    // with AI generated images)
    const mimeType = await getActualMimeTypeFromImage(file);
    if (mimeType && mimeType !== file.type) {
      file = createFile(file, mimeType, file.name);
    }
  }

  (file as any)[normalizedFileSymbol] = true;

  return file;
};
```

```typescript
import { FONT_FAMILY } from "@excalidraw/common";

import type { ExcalidrawTextElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import { Fonts } from "../fonts";
import { Excalidraw } from "../index";

import { API } from "./helpers/api";
import { Keyboard } from "./helpers/ui";
import {
  act,
  fireEvent,
  render,
  screen,
  unmountComponent,
  waitFor,
} from "./test-utils";

unmountComponent();

const { h } = window;

// "wOF2" signature + 4 header bytes
const FONT_BYTES = new Uint8Array([0x77, 0x4f, 0x46, 0x32, 0, 1, 0, 0]);
// djb2 of FONT_BYTES worked out by hand (h = h * 33 + byte, mod 2^32),
// offset by the custom range start (2000)
const FONT_ID = 3_498_734_455;
const TTF_BYTES = new Uint8Array([0x00, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0, 1, 0, 0]);

const fontFile = (bytes = FONT_BYTES, name = "Test Font.woff2") =>
  new File([bytes], name);

const openFontPicker = () => {
  const trigger = screen.getByTestId("font-family-show-fonts");
  act(() => {
    trigger.click();
  });
};

/** picks a file through the font picker's footer upload input */
const uploadThroughPicker = async (file: File) => {
  openFontPicker();
  expect(screen.getByTestId("font-picker-upload").textContent).toBe(
    "Upload font",
  );

  const input = screen.getByTestId("font-picker-upload-input");
  await act(async () => {
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { files: [file] } });
  });
};

/** ticks the license box and confirms the upload dialog */
const confirmUploadDialog = async () => {
  const checkbox = await screen.findByRole("checkbox");
  fireEvent.click(checkbox);
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Add font" }));
};

describe("uploading a custom font through the font picker (#140)", () => {
  const fontsAdd = vi.mocked(window.document.fonts.add);

  beforeAll(() => {
    (global as any).ResizeObserver =
      (global as any).ResizeObserver ||
      class ResizeObserver {
        observe() {}
        unobserve() {}
        disconnect() {}
      };
    // the jsdom `document.fonts` mock from setupTests.ts has no `delete`
    Object.assign(window.document.fonts, { delete: vi.fn() });
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await render(<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />);
    fontsAdd.mockClear();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(FONT_ID);
  });

  const addSelectedText = () => {
    const text = API.createElement({
      type: "text",
      text: "hello",
      fontFamily: FONT_FAMILY.Excalifont,
    }) as ExcalidrawTextElement;
    API.setElements([text]);
    API.setSelectedElements([text]);
    return text;
  };

  it("applies the uploaded font to the selected text", async () => {
    const text = addSelectedText();

    await uploadThroughPicker(fontFile());
    await confirmUploadDialog();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(
        (h.elements.find((el) => el.id === text.id) as ExcalidrawTextElement)
          .fontFamily,
      ).toBe(FONT_ID);
    });
    expect(h.state.currentItemFontFamily).toBe(FONT_ID);
  });

  it("registers the font under the name from the dialog", async () => {
    addSelectedText();

    await uploadThroughPicker(fontFile());
    await confirmUploadDialog();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(Fonts.registered.get(FONT_ID)?.metadata.custom).toEqual({
        name: "Test Font",
      });
    });
  });

  it("adds the font face to the document so it renders straight away", async () => {
    addSelectedText();

    await uploadThroughPicker(fontFile());
    await confirmUploadDialog();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(fontsAdd).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({ family: `ExcalidrawCustomFont-${FONT_ID}` }),
      );
    });
  });

  it("makes the font the default for new text when nothing is selected", async () => {
    Keyboard.keyPress("t");

    await uploadThroughPicker(fontFile());
    await confirmUploadDialog();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(h.state.currentItemFontFamily).toBe(FONT_ID);
    });
  });

  it("closes the picker and opens the upload dialog for the chosen file", async () => {
    addSelectedText();
    const file = fontFile();

    await uploadThroughPicker(file);

    expect(h.state.openPopup).toBeNull();
    expect(h.state.openDialog).toEqual({ name: "customFontUpload", file });
    expect(await screen.findByText("Add custom font")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("closes the dialog after adding the font", async () => {
    addSelectedText();

    await uploadThroughPicker(fontFile());
    await confirmUploadDialog();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(h.state.openDialog).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  it("lists the uploaded font in the picker under its name", async () => {
    addSelectedText();

    await uploadThroughPicker(fontFile());
    await confirmUploadDialog();
    await waitFor(() => expect(h.state.openDialog).toBeNull());

    openFontPicker();

    expect(screen.getByTitle("Test Font")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByTitle(`ExcalidrawCustomFont-${FONT_ID}`)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("leaves everything unchanged when the dialog is cancelled", async () => {
    const text = addSelectedText();

    await uploadThroughPicker(fontFile());
    await screen.findByRole("checkbox");
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }));

    expect(h.state.openDialog).toBeNull();
    expect(Fonts.registered.has(FONT_ID)).toBe(false);
    expect(
      (h.elements.find((el) => el.id === text.id) as ExcalidrawTextElement)
        .fontFamily,
    ).toBe(FONT_FAMILY.Excalifont);
  });

  it("selects the existing font when the same file is uploaded again", async () => {
    const text = addSelectedText();

    await uploadThroughPicker(fontFile());
    await confirmUploadDialog();
    await waitFor(() => expect(h.state.openDialog).toBeNull());

    // switch away, then upload the same bytes under a different name
    API.updateElement(text, { fontFamily: FONT_FAMILY.Nunito });
    await uploadThroughPicker(fontFile(FONT_BYTES, "Copy.woff2"));
    await confirmUploadDialog();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(
        (h.elements.find((el) => el.id === text.id) as ExcalidrawTextElement)
          .fontFamily,
      ).toBe(FONT_ID);
    });
    // the first upload's name is kept, no second entry
    expect(Fonts.registered.get(FONT_ID)?.metadata.custom).toEqual({
      name: "Test Font",
    });
    expect(
      Array.from(Fonts.registered.values()).filter((f) => f.metadata.custom),
    ).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it("shows an error for a TTF file and adds nothing", async () => {
    const text = addSelectedText();

    await uploadThroughPicker(fontFile(TTF_BYTES, "font.ttf"));

    expect((await screen.findByRole("alert")).textContent).toBe(
      "Only WOFF and WOFF2 font files are supported.",
    );
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }));

    expect(Fonts.registered.has(FONT_ID)).toBe(false);
    expect(
      (h.elements.find((el) => el.id === text.id) as ExcalidrawTextElement)
        .fontFamily,
    ).toBe(FONT_FAMILY.Excalifont);
  });
});
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-13 02:23:26Z)**_

Step 5 is done: the **Upload font** button works end to end. Nothing is staged.

**What happens now:** the user opens the font picker and clicks **Upload font** in the footer under the list. The file chooser opens, filtered to `.woff` and `.woff2`. When they pick a file:

1. The picker closes and step 4's dialog opens.
2. When they tick the license box and click **Add font**, the font is registered and applied to the selected text. With nothing selected, it becomes the font for new text.
3. The font then appears in the picker under the name they gave it.

Uploading the same file again just selects the existing font.

**What changed:**

- **[FontPickerList.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/FontPicker/FontPickerList.tsx):** the footer with the Upload font button and a hidden file input. Step 9 will add the Remove toggle beside it.
- **[FontPicker.scss](packages/excalidraw/components/FontPicker/FontPicker.scss):** styles for the footer.
- **[App.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx):** `openCustomFontUploadDialog` and `closeCustomFontUploadDialog`.
- **[LayerUI.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/LayerUI.tsx):** shows the dialog when it's open.
- **[types.ts](packages/excalidraw/types.ts):** the new `customFontUpload` dialog type, and the new `App` methods made available to the UI.
- **[Fonts.ts](packages/excalidraw/fonts/Fonts.ts):** the step 2 fix, so a newly uploaded font renders straight away instead of after a reload.
- **`en.json`:** the "Upload font" label.

**Two bugs I hit and fixed while testing:**

1. **The dialog reopened after you clicked Add.** Applying the font restored the app state from just before the dialog closed. The font is now applied first and the dialog closed after. The test "closes the dialog after adding the font" guards this.
2. **The font picker stayed open behind the dialog.** The picker's own close handler doesn't close it, so opening the dialog now closes the picker too.

```text
import { Popover } from "radix-ui";
import clsx from "clsx";
import React, { type ReactNode } from "react";

import { isInteractive } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { useEditorInterface } from "./App";
import { Island } from "./Island";

interface PropertiesPopoverProps {
  className?: string;
  container: HTMLDivElement | null;
  children: ReactNode;
  style?: object;
  onClose: () => void;
  onKeyDown?: React.KeyboardEventHandler<HTMLDivElement>;
  onPointerLeave?: React.PointerEventHandler<HTMLDivElement>;
  onFocusOutside?: Popover.PopoverContentProps["onFocusOutside"];
  onPointerDownOutside?: Popover.PopoverContentProps["onPointerDownOutside"];
  preventAutoFocusOnTouch?: boolean;
}

export const PropertiesPopover = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  PropertiesPopoverProps
>(
  (
    {
      className,
      container,
      children,
      style,
      onClose,
      onKeyDown,
      onFocusOutside,
      onPointerLeave,
      onPointerDownOutside,
      preventAutoFocusOnTouch = false,
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const editorInterface = useEditorInterface();
    const isMobilePortrait =
      editorInterface.formFactor === "phone" && !editorInterface.isLandscape;

    return (
      <Popover.Portal container={container}>
        <Popover.Content
          ref={ref}
          className={clsx("focus-visible-none", className)}
          data-prevent-outside-click
          side={isMobilePortrait ? "bottom" : "right"}
          align={isMobilePortrait ? "center" : "start"}
          alignOffset={-16}
          sideOffset={20}
          collisionBoundary={container ?? undefined}
          style={{
            zIndex: "var(--zIndex-ui-styles-popup)",
            marginLeft:
              editorInterface.formFactor === "phone" ? "0.5rem" : undefined,
          }}
          onPointerLeave={onPointerLeave}
          onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
          onFocusOutside={onFocusOutside}
          onPointerDownOutside={onPointerDownOutside}
          onOpenAutoFocus={(e) => {
            // prevent auto-focus on touch devices to avoid keyboard popup
            if (preventAutoFocusOnTouch && editorInterface.isTouchScreen) {
              e.preventDefault();
            }
          }}
          onCloseAutoFocus={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            // prevents focusing the trigger
            e.preventDefault();

            // return focus to excalidraw container unless
            // user focuses an interactive element, such as a button, or
            // enters the text editor by clicking on canvas with the text tool
            if (container && !isInteractive(document.activeElement)) {
              container.focus();
            }

            onClose();
          }}
        >
          <Island padding={3} style={style}>
            {children}
          </Island>
          <Popover.Arrow
            width={20}
            height={10}
            style={{
              fill: "var(--popup-bg-color)",
              filter: "drop-shadow(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 3px 2px)",
            }}
          />
        </Popover.Content>
      </Popover.Portal>
    );
  },
);
```

</details></tool-use>

```javascript
// Reproduces the custom font upload flow (#140) in a real browser.
const path = require("path");
const puppeteer = require("c:/excalidraw/node_modules/puppeteer-core");

const OUT = __dirname;
const FONT = path.join(
  process.env.USERPROFILE,
  "Downloads",
  "Seramonde Trial.woff2",
);
const URL = process.argv[2] || "http://localhost:3001";

const log = (...args) => console.log("[repro]", ...args);
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

(async () => {
  const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
    executablePath: "C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe",
    headless: true,
    args: ["--window-size=1400,900"],
    defaultViewport: { width: 1400, height: 900 },
  });
  const page = await browser.newPage();
  page.on("console", (msg) => {
    if (["error", "warning"].includes(msg.type())) {
      log(`console.${msg.type()}:`, msg.text().slice(0, 300));
    }
  });
  page.on("pageerror", (err) => log("PAGE ERROR:", err.message));

  await page.goto(URL, { waitUntil: "networkidle2", timeout: 60000 });
  await page.waitForSelector(".excalidraw", { timeout: 60000 });
  await sleep(1500);
  // dismiss the welcome screen / focus the canvas
  await page.mouse.click(700, 450);
  await page.keyboard.press("t");
  await sleep(500);

  const trigger = await page.$('[data-testid="font-family-show-fonts"]');
  log("font picker trigger found:", !!trigger);
  if (!trigger) {
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(OUT, "repro-0-no-trigger.png") });
    await browser.close();
    return;
  }
  await trigger.click();
  await sleep(500);

  const uploadBtn = await page.$('[data-testid="font-picker-upload"]');
  log("upload button found:", !!uploadBtn);
  await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(OUT, "repro-1-picker-open.png") });
  if (!uploadBtn) {
    await browser.close();
    return;
  }

  const [chooser] = await Promise.all([
    page.waitForFileChooser({ timeout: 5000 }).catch((e) => {
      log("NO FILE CHOOSER:", e.message);
      return null;
    }),
    uploadBtn.click(),
  ]);
  if (!chooser) {
    await browser.close();
    return;
  }
  log("file chooser opened, accepting", FONT);

  const pickerOpenBefore = !!(await page.$(
    '[data-testid="font-picker-upload-input"]',
  ));
  log("hidden input still mounted when chooser opened:", pickerOpenBefore);

  await chooser.accept([FONT]);
  await sleep(1500);

  const state = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const dialogTitle = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll("h2, .Dialog__title"),
    )
      .map((el) => el.textContent)
      .find((t) => t && t.includes("custom font"));
    return {
      dialogTitle: dialogTitle || null,
      inputMounted: !!document.querySelector(
        '[data-testid="font-picker-upload-input"]',
      ),
      alert: document.querySelector('[role="alert"]')?.textContent ?? null,
      loading: document.body.innerText.includes("Reading font file"),
    };
  });
  log("after choosing the file:", JSON.stringify(state));
  await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(OUT, "repro-2-after-choose.png") });

  await browser.close();
})().catch((e) => {
  console.error("[repro] SCRIPT ERROR", e);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

The screenshot above shows "Seramonde test" drawn in the uploaded font.

So the code works. The most likely cause is that **your browser tab was running stale code.** Your tab was probably open before step 5's changes. Vite hot-reloaded the picker, so the new button appeared, but `App` is a class component that hot reload often doesn't fully replace. Clicking would then call `app.openCustomFontUploadDialog` on an old `App` that doesn't have it, and the error happens silently in the console. That matches "nothing occurred" exactly.

**Try this:**

1. Hard-reload the tab with **Ctrl+Shift+R**.
2. Open DevTools (**F12**) and go to the **Console** tab.
3. Upload the file again.

**If it still does nothing,** tell me:

- Whether the "Add custom font" dialog appears at all, or nothing happens after you pick the file.
- Any red error in the console. Something like `openCustomFontUploadDialog is not a function` would confirm the stale-code theory.
- Which browser you're using.

Also, uploaded fonts don't survive a page reload yet (that's step 6). After the hard reload, the font has to be uploaded again.

I didn't change any repo files while investigating. The repro script and screenshots are in the scratchpad, and the script is at `C:\Users\ab200\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\7985df2d02985ab2\7311c317-21b1-44c8-ab86-1e60ec313e46\scratchpad\repro-upload.js`.
