Fixed. When you double-clicked the file, the second click landed on the canvas and closed the font picker. That removed the hidden file input inside it, so your file was silently thrown away. Pressing **Open** happened to work because the picker stayed open.

**The fix:** the Upload font button now uses the browser's file picker API through a new `openCustomFontFile()` helper in [customFonts.ts](packages/excalidraw/data/customFonts.ts). This is the same `browser-fs-access` library Excalidraw already uses for opening images and scenes. The chosen file comes back directly to the button's click handler, so it doesn't matter whether the picker is still open. The hidden input is gone from [FontPickerList.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/FontPicker/FontPickerList.tsx). Cancelling the file chooser now does nothing, silently.

```javascript
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const puppeteer = require("c:/excalidraw/node_modules/puppeteer-core");

const FONT = path.join(
  process.env.USERPROFILE,
  "Downloads",
  "Seramonde Trial.woff2",
);
const URL = "http://localhost:3001";
const mode = process.argv[2] || "--selected";
const log = (...a) => console.log("[repro]", ...a);
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

(async () => {
  const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
    executablePath: "C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe",
    headless: true,
    defaultViewport: { width: 1400, height: 900 },

  page.on("pageerror", (e) => log("PAGE ERROR:", e.message));

  const base64 = fs.readFileSync(FONT).toString("base64");

    window.showOpenFilePicker = async () => {
      const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(b64), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
      const file = new File([bytes], "Seramonde Trial.woff2");
      return [{ kind: "file", name: file.name, getFile: async () => file }];
    };
  }, base64);

  await page.goto(URL, { waitUntil: "networkidle2", timeout: 60000 });

  await page.keyboard.press("t");
  await sleep(300);

  if (mode === "--editing" || mode === "--editing-empty") {
    await page.mouse.click(700, 450);
    await sleep(300);
    if (mode === "--editing") {
      await page.keyboard.type("Hello");
    }
  } else {
    await page.mouse.click(700, 450);
    await sleep(300);
    await page.keyboard.type("Hello");
    await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
    await sleep(300);
```

```text
import {
  EXPORT_DATA_TYPES,
  getExportSource,
  MIME_TYPES,
  VERSIONS,
} from "@excalidraw/common";

import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import type { MaybePromise } from "@excalidraw/common/utility-types";

import { cleanAppStateForExport, clearAppStateForDatabase } from "../appState";

import { isImageFileHandle, loadFromBlob } from "./blob";
import { fileOpen, fileSave } from "./filesystem";

import type { AppState, BinaryFiles, LibraryItems } from "../types";
import type {
  ExportedDataState,
  ImportedDataState,
  ExportedLibraryData,
  ImportedLibraryData,
} from "./types";

export type JSONExportData = {
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[];
  appState: AppState;
  files: BinaryFiles;
};

/**
 * Strips out files which are only referenced by deleted elements
 */
const filterOutDeletedFiles = (
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
  files: BinaryFiles,
) => {
  const nextFiles: BinaryFiles = {};
  for (const element of elements) {
    if (
      !element.isDeleted &&
      "fileId" in element &&
      element.fileId &&
      files[element.fileId]
    ) {
      nextFiles[element.fileId] = files[element.fileId];
    }
  }
  return nextFiles;
};

export const serializeAsJSON = (
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
  appState: Partial<AppState>,
  files: BinaryFiles,
  type: "local" | "database",
): string => {
  const data: ExportedDataState = {
    type: EXPORT_DATA_TYPES.excalidraw,
    version: VERSIONS.excalidraw,
    source: getExportSource(),
    elements,
    appState:
      type === "local"
        ? cleanAppStateForExport(appState)
        : clearAppStateForDatabase(appState),
    files:
      type === "local"
        ? filterOutDeletedFiles(elements, files)
        : // will be stripped from JSON
          undefined,
  };

  return JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
};
```

<tool-use data-tool-type="generic" data-tool-name="AskUserQuestion"><details>

<summary>Tool use: **AskUserQuestion**</summary>
**After a page reload, which uploaded custom fonts should still be available in the font picker?**

Options:

- **All uploaded fonts (Recommended)** - Kept in the browser like your library, so every font you've uploaded stays in the picker for any drawing until you remove it (step 9).
- **Only fonts used in the scene** - Fonts only stay if text in the current drawing uses them; unused uploads disappear on reload.

**When a drawing is saved as a .excalidraw file, which custom fonts should be embedded in it?**

Options:

- **Only fonts the text uses (Recommended)** - Keeps files small (fonts can be up to 5 MB each); matches how unused images are already dropped on save.
- **All uploaded fonts** - Anyone opening the file gets your whole font collection, even fonts no text uses.

**Answer:** All uploaded fonts (Recommended), Only fonts the text uses (Recommended)

</details></tool-use>

```text
export const loadSceneOrLibraryFromBlob = async (
  blob: Blob | File,
  /** @see restore.localAppState */
  localAppState: AppState | null,
  localElements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[] | null,
  /** FileSystemFileHandle. Defaults to `blob.handle` if defined, otherwise null. */
  fileHandle?: FileSystemFileHandle | null,
) => {
  const contents = await parseFileContents(blob);
  let data;
  try {
    try {
      data = JSON.parse(contents);
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (isSupportedImageFile(blob)) {
        throw new ImageSceneDataError(
          "Image doesn't contain scene",
          "IMAGE_NOT_CONTAINS_SCENE_DATA",
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
    if (isValidExcalidrawData(data)) {
      const cleanedAppState = cleanAppStateForExport(data.appState || {});
      // the name isn't retained across export/import, so derive it from the
      // opened file itself (native file handle, or the input's file name)
      const openedFileName = fileHandle?.name || blob.handle?.name || blob.name;
      return {
        type: MIME_TYPES.excalidraw,
        data: {
          elements: restoreElements(data.elements, localElements, {
            repairBindings: true,
            deleteInvisibleElements: true,
          }),
          appState: restoreAppState(
            {
              theme: localAppState?.theme,
              fileHandle: fileHandle || blob.handle || null,
              ...cleanedAppState,
              name: openedFileName
                ? getNameWithoutExtension(openedFileName)
                : null,
              ...(localAppState
                ? getScrollToContentState(data.elements || [], localAppState)
                : {}),
            },
            localAppState,
          ),
          files: data.files || {},
        },
      };
    } else if (isValidLibrary(data)) {
      return {
        type: MIME_TYPES.excalidrawlib,
        data,
      };
    }
    throw new Error("Error: invalid file");
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error instanceof ImageSceneDataError) {
      throw error;
    }
    throw new Error("Error: invalid file");
  }
};

export const loadFromBlob = async (
  blob: Blob,
  /** @see restore.localAppState */
  localAppState: AppState | null,
```

<summary>Tool use: **Bash**</summary>
Append restoreCustomFonts and check blob imports

```bash
cd /c/excalidraw; cat >> packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts <<'EOF'

const customFontMimeTypes: readonly string[] = Object.values(
  CUSTOM_FONT_MIME_TYPES,
);

/**
 * Validates user-uploaded fonts (#140) read from a scene file or storage,
 * which may come from anyone. Drops malformed entries, duplicate ids and
 * fonts over the upload size limit instead of failing the whole load.
 */
export const restoreCustomFonts = (input: unknown): CustomFontData[] => {
  if (!Array.isArray(input)) {
    return [];
  }

  const restored = new Map<number, CustomFontData>();

  for (const font of input) {
    if (!font || typeof font !== "object") {
      continue;
    }
    const { id, name, mimeType, dataURL, licenseAcknowledged, created } =
      font as Record<string, unknown>;

    if (
      typeof id !== "number" ||
      !isCustomFontFamily(id) ||
      restored.has(id) ||
      typeof name !== "string" ||
      !name.trim() ||
      typeof mimeType !== "string" ||
      !customFontMimeTypes.includes(mimeType) ||
      typeof dataURL !== "string" ||
      !dataURL.startsWith(`data:${mimeType};base64,`)
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    // base64 encodes 3 bytes in 4 characters
    const base64Length = dataURL.length - `data:${mimeType};base64,`.length;
    if ((base64Length * 3) / 4 > CUSTOM_FONT_MAX_SIZE_BYTES + 2) {
      continue;
    }

    restored.set(id, {
      id,
      name: name.trim(),
      mimeType: mimeType as CustomFontData["mimeType"],
      dataURL: dataURL as DataURL,
      licenseAcknowledged: licenseAcknowledged === true,
      created: typeof created === "number" ? created : Date.now(),
    });
  }

  return Array.from(restored.values());
};
EOF
```

```typescript
import { restoreCustomFonts } from "./restore";

const WOFF2_URL = "data:font/woff2;base64,d09GMgABAAAAAA==";

const valid = {
  id: 2007,
  name: "My Font",
  mimeType: "font/woff2",
  dataURL: WOFF2_URL,
  licenseAcknowledged: true,
  created: 1234,
};

describe("restoreCustomFonts() (#140)", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it("keeps a valid font as it is", () => {
    expect(restoreCustomFonts([valid])).toEqual([valid]);
  });

  it("accepts WOFF fonts", () => {
    const woff = {
      ...valid,
      mimeType: "font/woff",
      dataURL: "data:font/woff;base64,d09GRg==",
    };
    expect(restoreCustomFonts([woff])).toEqual([woff]);
  });

  it("returns nothing for missing or non-array input", () => {
    for (const input of [undefined, null, {}, "fonts", 42, { 0: valid }]) {
      expect(restoreCustomFonts(input)).toEqual([]);
    }
  });

  it("drops entries that aren't objects", () => {
    expect(restoreCustomFonts([null, "font", 2007, valid])).toEqual([valid]);
  });

  it.each([
    ["a built-in font id", { id: 5 }],
    ["an id just below the custom range", { id: 1999 }],
    ["a non-integer id", { id: 2007.5 }],
    ["a string id", { id: "2007" }],
    ["a missing name", { name: undefined }],
    ["a blank name", { name: "   " }],
    ["a non-string name", { name: 42 }],
    ["a TTF mime type", { mimeType: "font/ttf" }],
    ["a missing mime type", { mimeType: undefined }],
    [
      "a data URL that doesn't match the mime type",
      { dataURL: "data:font/woff;base64,d09GRg==" },
    ],
    ["a non-data URL", { dataURL: "https://example.com/font.woff2" }],
    ["a missing data URL", { dataURL: undefined }],
  ])("drops a font with %s", (_, override) => {
    expect(restoreCustomFonts([{ ...valid, ...override }])).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("keeps only the first font for a duplicate id", () => {
    expect(
      restoreCustomFonts([valid, { ...valid, name: "Duplicate" }]),
    ).toEqual([valid]);
  });

  it("trims the name", () => {
    expect(restoreCustomFonts([{ ...valid, name: "  Padded  " }])[0].name).toBe(
      "Padded",
    );
  });

  it("only treats an explicit true as an acknowledged license", () => {
    for (const licenseAcknowledged of [undefined, "true", 1, false]) {
      expect(
        restoreCustomFonts([{ ...valid, licenseAcknowledged }])[0]
          .licenseAcknowledged,
      ).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it("fills in a missing upload time with the current time", () => {
    vi.spyOn(Date, "now").mockReturnValue(9999);

    expect(
      restoreCustomFonts([{ ...valid, created: undefined }])[0].created,
    ).toBe(9999);
  });

  describe("size limit", () => {
    // a 5 MB (5,242,880 byte) font is ceil(5242880 / 3) * 4 = 6,990,508
    // base64 characters long
    const base64OfLength = (length: number) =>
      `data:font/woff2;base64,${"A".repeat(length)}`;

    it("accepts a font at the 5 MB upload limit", () => {
      expect(
        restoreCustomFonts([{ ...valid, dataURL: base64OfLength(6_990_508) }]),
      ).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    it("drops a font over the 5 MB upload limit", () => {
      // 4 more characters = 3 more bytes than the limit allows
      expect(
        restoreCustomFonts([{ ...valid, dataURL: base64OfLength(6_990_512) }]),
      ).toEqual([]);
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
  created: 2,
};

const text = (fontFamily: number, isDeleted = false) =>
  API.createElement({
    type: "text",
    text: "hello",
    fontFamily,
    isDeleted,
  }) as ExcalidrawTextElement;

const save = (
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawTextElement[],
  type: "local" | "database" = "local",
) => JSON.parse(serializeAsJSON(elements, getDefaultAppState(), {}, type));

const open = (json: object) =>
  loadFromBlob(
    new Blob([JSON.stringify(json)], { type: "application/json" }),
    null,
    null,
  );

describe("saving and opening scenes with custom fonts (#140)", () => {
  beforeAll(() => {
    // the jsdom `document.fonts` mock from setupTests.ts has no `delete`
    Object.assign(window.document.fonts, { delete: vi.fn() });
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(fontA.id);
    Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(fontB.id);
  });

  describe("saving", () => {
    it("embeds the fonts used by the scene's text", () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);

      expect(save([text(fontA.id)]).customFonts).toEqual([fontA]);
    });

    it("leaves out uploaded fonts that no text uses", () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontB);

      expect(save([text(fontA.id)]).customFonts).toEqual([fontA]);
    });

    it("leaves out fonts only used by deleted text", () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontB);

      expect(save([text(fontA.id), text(fontB.id, true)]).customFonts).toEqual([
        fontA,
      ]);
    });

    it("omits the field entirely when no custom font is used", () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);

      expect(save([text(FONT_FAMILY.Excalifont)])).not.toHaveProperty(
        "customFonts",
      );
    });

    it("doesn't send fonts to the database (no collaboration sync)", () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);

      expect(save([text(fontA.id)], "database")).not.toHaveProperty(
        "customFonts",
      );
    });
  });

  describe("opening", () => {
    it("restores the fonts and the text that uses them", async () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);
      const saved = save([text(fontA.id)]);
      // as if opened in a fresh browser
      Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(fontA.id);

      const { elements } = await open(saved);

      expect(Fonts.getCustomFonts()).toEqual([fontA]);
      expect((elements[0] as ExcalidrawTextElement).fontFamily).toBe(fontA.id);
    });

    it("keeps the local font when the file embeds the same font under another name", async () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);

      await open({
        type: "excalidraw",
        version: 2,
        elements: [text(fontA.id)],
        customFonts: [{ ...fontA, name: "Renamed elsewhere" }],
      });

      expect(Fonts.getCustomFonts()).toEqual([fontA]);
    });

    it("skips invalid embedded fonts and still opens the scene", async () => {
      const { elements } = await open({
        type: "excalidraw",
        version: 2,
        elements: [text(fontA.id)],
        customFonts: [{ ...fontB, mimeType: "font/ttf" }, fontA, "junk"],
      });

      expect(Fonts.getCustomFonts()).toEqual([fontA]);
      expect(elements).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    it("opens files saved before custom fonts existed", async () => {
      const { elements } = await open({
        type: "excalidraw",
        version: 2,
        elements: [text(FONT_FAMILY.Nunito)],
      });

      expect(Fonts.getCustomFonts()).toEqual([]);
      expect((elements[0] as ExcalidrawTextElement).fontFamily).toBe(
        FONT_FAMILY.Nunito,
      );
    });
  });
});
```

Step 6a is done: custom fonts now travel inside saved `.excalidraw` files and come back when the file is opened. Nothing is staged. A page reload still loses uploaded fonts; that's 6b.

**What changed:**

- **[Fonts.ts](packages/excalidraw/fonts/Fonts.ts):** the registry keeps each font's full data. Two new functions:
  - `getCustomFonts()` returns every uploaded font.
  - `getCustomFontsUsedBy(elements)` returns only the fonts used by non-deleted text.
  - `registerCustomFont` now takes the full `CustomFontData`.
- **[json.ts](packages/excalidraw/data/json.ts):** `serializeAsJSON` adds a `customFonts` list to saved files with only the fonts the text uses. With no custom fonts, the field is left out, so existing files and snapshots are byte-for-byte unchanged. Fonts are never sent to the database, matching your decision that collaboration is out of scope.
- **[restore.ts](packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts):** new `restoreCustomFonts()` checks fonts embedded in a file before trusting them. It drops bad IDs, blank names, TTF or mismatched types, non-data URLs, duplicates, and fonts over 5 MB. One bad font doesn't stop the rest of the file from opening.
- **[blob.ts](packages/excalidraw/data/blob.ts):** opening a file registers its valid fonts before laying out text. If you already have the same font under a different name, your local name is kept.
- **[data/types.ts](packages/excalidraw/data/types.ts):** the file format types gain an optional `customFonts` field.
- **Constants:** the 5 MB limit moved into `@excalidraw/common` so `restore.ts` can use it without an import cycle. `customFonts.ts` re-exports it, so nothing else had to change.

**Test run:** 46 of 46 pass in the three test files below, including the updated step 2 registry tests. The wider regression run passed **286 of 286** across 19 files: save/load, restore, export, library, images, and all custom-font suites. No snapshots changed.

```typescript
import { createStore, setMany, values } from "idb-keyval";

import { Fonts, restoreCustomFonts } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw";

import type { CustomFontData } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/types";

import { STORAGE_KEYS } from "../app_constants";

/**
 * Keeps every uploaded custom font (#140) in IndexedDB, so it stays in the
 * font picker across reloads for any drawing. Fonts can be up to 5 MB each,
 * too big for localStorage.
 */
export class CustomFontsStorage {
  private static store = createStore(
    `${STORAGE_KEYS.IDB_CUSTOM_FONTS}-db`,
    `${STORAGE_KEYS.IDB_CUSTOM_FONTS}-store`,
  );

  /** ids already in IndexedDB, so saving on every change stays cheap */
  private static savedIds = new Set<number>();

  /** Registers all saved fonts. Call before the scene's text is laid out. */
  static async restore(): Promise<CustomFontData[]> {
    try {
      // stored data is still validated, it may predate a format change
      const fonts = restoreCustomFonts(await values(this.store));
      for (const font of fonts) {
        Fonts.registerCustomFont(font);
        this.savedIds.add(font.id);
      }
      return fonts;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Couldn't restore custom fonts", error);
      return [];
    }
  }

  /** Saves the given fonts that aren't in IndexedDB yet. */
  static async saveNew(fonts: readonly CustomFontData[]): Promise<void> {
    const unsaved = fonts.filter((font) => !this.savedIds.has(font.id));
    if (!unsaved.length) {
      return;
    }

    // mark first, so concurrent change events don't write the same font twice
    unsaved.forEach((font) => this.savedIds.add(font.id));
    try {
      await setMany(
        unsaved.map((font) => [font.id, font]),
        this.store,
      );
    } catch (error) {
      unsaved.forEach((font) => this.savedIds.delete(font.id));
      console.error("Couldn't save custom fonts", error);
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { IDBFactory } from "fake-indexeddb";

import type { CustomFontData, DataURL } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/types";

const fontA: CustomFontData = {
  id: 2007,
  name: "Font A",
  mimeType: "font/woff2",
  dataURL: "data:font/woff2;base64,d09GMgABAAAAAA==" as DataURL,
  licenseAcknowledged: true,
  created: 1,
};

const fontB: CustomFontData = {
  id: 2042,
  name: "Font B",
  mimeType: "font/woff",
  dataURL: "data:font/woff;base64,d09GRgABAAAAAA==" as DataURL,
  licenseAcknowledged: true,
  created: 2,
};

/**
 * Fresh IndexedDB + fresh modules, i.e. a page reload: the storage's in-memory
 * state and the font registry both start empty. Pass the previous `idb` to
 * keep the stored data, like a real reload does.
 */
const reload = async (idb = new IDBFactory()) => {
  globalThis.indexedDB = idb;
  vi.resetModules();
  const { CustomFontsStorage } = await import("../data/customFontsStorage");
  const { Fonts } = await import("@excalidraw/excalidraw");
  const idbKeyval = await import("idb-keyval");
  const store = idbKeyval.createStore(
    "excalidraw-custom-fonts-db",
    "excalidraw-custom-fonts-store",
  );
  return { CustomFontsStorage, Fonts, idb, idbKeyval, store };
};

describe("CustomFontsStorage (#140)", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it("restores nothing when no font was ever saved", async () => {
    const { CustomFontsStorage, Fonts } = await reload();

    expect(await CustomFontsStorage.restore()).toEqual([]);
    expect(Fonts.getCustomFonts()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("brings every saved font back into the picker after a reload", async () => {
    const before = await reload();
    await before.CustomFontsStorage.saveNew([fontA, fontB]);

    const after = await reload(before.idb);
    const restored = await after.CustomFontsStorage.restore();

    expect(restored).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([fontA, fontB]));
    expect(restored).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(after.Fonts.getCustomFonts()).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining([fontA, fontB]),
    );
    expect(after.Fonts.registered.get(fontA.id)?.metadata.custom).toEqual({
      name: "Font A",
    });
  });

  it("keeps fonts that no drawing uses", async () => {
    // saveNew gets every uploaded font, not just the ones the scene uses
    const before = await reload();
    await before.CustomFontsStorage.saveNew([fontA]);

    const after = await reload(before.idb);

    expect(await after.CustomFontsStorage.restore()).toEqual([fontA]);
  });

  it("writes each font only once, however often the scene changes", async () => {
    const { CustomFontsStorage, idbKeyval } = await reload();
    const setMany = vi.spyOn(idbKeyval, "setMany");

    await CustomFontsStorage.saveNew([fontA]);
    await CustomFontsStorage.saveNew([fontA]);
    await CustomFontsStorage.saveNew([fontA, fontB]);

    expect(setMany).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(setMany.mock.calls[0][0]).toEqual([[fontA.id, fontA]]);
    expect(setMany.mock.calls[1][0]).toEqual([[fontB.id, fontB]]);
  });

  it("doesn't rewrite fonts that were restored from storage", async () => {
    const before = await reload();
    await before.CustomFontsStorage.saveNew([fontA]);

    const after = await reload(before.idb);
    await after.CustomFontsStorage.restore();
    const setMany = vi.spyOn(after.idbKeyval, "setMany");
    await after.CustomFontsStorage.saveNew(after.Fonts.getCustomFonts());

    expect(setMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("skips invalid stored entries", async () => {
    const before = await reload();
    await before.idbKeyval.setMany(
      [
        [fontA.id, fontA],
        [5, { ...fontB, id: 5 }],
        ["junk", "not a font"],
      ],
      before.store,
    );

    const after = await reload(before.idb);

    expect(await after.CustomFontsStorage.restore()).toEqual([fontA]);
  });

  it("starts without custom fonts if IndexedDB can't be read", async () => {
    const { CustomFontsStorage, idbKeyval } = await reload();
    vi.spyOn(idbKeyval, "values").mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error("blocked"));
    const error = vi.spyOn(console, "error").mockImplementation(() => {});

    expect(await CustomFontsStorage.restore()).toEqual([]);
    expect(error).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("retries a font whose save failed on the next change", async () => {
    const { CustomFontsStorage, idbKeyval } = await reload();
    const setMany = vi
      .spyOn(idbKeyval, "setMany")
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error("quota"));
    vi.spyOn(console, "error").mockImplementation(() => {});

    await CustomFontsStorage.saveNew([fontA]);
    await CustomFontsStorage.saveNew([fontA]);

    expect(setMany).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });
});
```

```typescript
/**
 * Keeps every uploaded custom font (#140) in IndexedDB, so it stays in the
 * font picker across reloads for any drawing. Fonts can be up to 5 MB each,
 * too big for localStorage.
 */
export class CustomFontsStorage {
  /** ids already in IndexedDB, so saving on every change stays cheap */
  private readonly savedIds = new Set<number>();

  constructor(private readonly store: UseStore) {}

  /** Registers all saved fonts. Call before the scene's text is laid out. */
  async restore(): Promise<CustomFontData[]> {
    try {
      // stored data is still validated, it may predate a format change
      const fonts = restoreCustomFonts(await values(this.store));
      for (const font of fonts) {
        Fonts.registerCustomFont(font);
        this.savedIds.add(font.id);
      }
      return fonts;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Couldn't restore custom fonts", error);
      return [];
    }
  }

  /** Saves the given fonts that aren't in IndexedDB yet. */
  async saveNew(fonts: readonly CustomFontData[]): Promise<void> {
    const unsaved = fonts.filter((font) => !this.savedIds.has(font.id));
    if (!unsaved.length) {
      return;
    }

    // mark first, so concurrent change events don't write the same font twice
    unsaved.forEach((font) => this.savedIds.add(font.id));
    try {
      await setMany(
        unsaved.map((font) => [font.id, font]),
        this.store,
      );
    } catch (error) {
      unsaved.forEach((font) => this.savedIds.delete(font.id));
      console.error("Couldn't save custom fonts", error);
    }
  }
}

export const customFontsStorage = new CustomFontsStorage(
  createStore(
    `${STORAGE_KEYS.IDB_CUSTOM_FONTS}-db`,
    `${STORAGE_KEYS.IDB_CUSTOM_FONTS}-store`,
  ),
);
```

```typescript
};

const fontB: CustomFontData = {

  name: "Font B",

describe("CustomFontsStorage (#140)", () => {
  // a fresh database per test (fake-indexeddb is loaded in setupTests.ts)
  let store: ReturnType<typeof createStore>;

  /** a new storage over the same database, i.e. after a page reload */
  const reload = () => {
    Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(fontA.id);
    Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(fontB.id);
    return new CustomFontsStorage(store);
  };

  beforeAll(() => {
    // the jsdom `document.fonts` mock from setupTests.ts has no `delete`
    Object.assign(window.document.fonts, { delete: vi.fn() });
  });

  beforeEach(() => {
    store = createStore(`custom-fonts-test-${++dbCount}`, "store");
    vi.mocked(setMany).mockClear();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(fontA.id);
    Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(fontB.id);
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it("restores nothing when no font was ever saved", async () => {
    expect(await reload().restore()).toEqual([]);
    expect(Fonts.getCustomFonts()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("brings every saved font back into the picker after a reload", async () => {
    await reload().saveNew([fontA, fontB]);

    const restored = await reload().restore();

    expect(restored).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(restored).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([fontA, fontB]));
    expect(Fonts.getCustomFonts()).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining([fontA, fontB]),
    );
    expect(Fonts.registered.get(fontA.id)?.metadata.custom).toEqual({
      name: "Font A",
    });
  });

  it("writes each font only once, however often the scene changes", async () => {
    const storage = reload();

    await storage.saveNew([fontA]);
    await storage.saveNew([fontA]);
    await storage.saveNew([fontA, fontB]);

    expect(setMany).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(vi.mocked(setMany).mock.calls[0][0]).toEqual([[fontA.id, fontA]]);
    expect(vi.mocked(setMany).mock.calls[1][0]).toEqual([[fontB.id, fontB]]);
  });

  it("doesn't rewrite fonts it restored from storage", async () => {
    await reload().saveNew([fontA]);
    vi.mocked(setMany).mockClear();

    const storage = reload();
    await storage.restore();
    await storage.saveNew(Fonts.getCustomFonts());

    expect(setMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("skips invalid stored entries", async () => {
    await setMany(
      [
        [fontA.id, fontA],
        [5, { ...fontB, id: 5 }],
        ["junk", "not a font"],
      ],
      store,
    );

    expect(await reload().restore()).toEqual([fontA]);
  });

  it("starts without custom fonts if IndexedDB can't be read", async () => {
    vi.mocked(values).mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error("blocked"));
    const error = vi.spyOn(console, "error").mockImplementation(() => {});

    expect(await reload().restore()).toEqual([]);
    expect(error).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("retries a font whose save failed on the next change", async () => {
    vi.mocked(setMany).mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error("quota"));
    vi.spyOn(console, "error").mockImplementation(() => {});
    const storage = reload();

    await storage.saveNew([fontA]);
    await storage.saveNew([fontA]);

    expect(setMany).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(await reload().restore()).toEqual([fontA]);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { Fonts } from "../fonts";
import { t } from "../i18n";

import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import "./CustomFontsLicenseNotice.scss";

/**
 * Reminds the user that exports embed the uploaded fonts (#140) their text
 * uses, so the fonts' licenses must allow distribution. Renders nothing when
 * no custom font is used.
 */
export const CustomFontsLicenseNotice = ({
  elements,
}: {
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[];
}) => {
  const fonts = Fonts.getCustomFontsUsedBy(elements);

  if (!fonts.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <p className="CustomFontsLicenseNotice" role="note">
      {t("customFontLicenseNotice", {
        fonts: fonts.map((font) => font.name).join(", "),
      })}
    </p>
  );
};
```

```typescript
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

import { FONT_FAMILY } from "@excalidraw/common";

import type { ExcalidrawTextElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import { CustomFontsLicenseNotice } from "../components/CustomFontsLicenseNotice";
import { Fonts } from "../fonts";
import { Excalidraw } from "../index";
import * as exportUtils from "../scene/export";

import { API } from "./helpers/api";
import { render, screen, unmountComponent, waitFor } from "./test-utils";

import type { CustomFontData, DataURL } from "../types";

unmountComponent();

const { h } = window;

// a real WOFF2 file (one of the bundled Excalifont subsets) stands in for an
// uploaded font, so export runs the real fetch → subset → inline path
const WOFF2_BYTES = fs.readFileSync(
  path.resolve(
    __dirname,
    "../fonts/Excalifont/Excalifont-Regular-be310b9bcd4f1a43f571c46df7809174.woff2",
  ),
);

const font = (id: number, name: string): CustomFontData => ({
  id,
  name,
  mimeType: "font/woff2",
  dataURL: `data:font/woff2;base64,${WOFF2_BYTES.toString(
    "base64",
  )}` as DataURL,
  licenseAcknowledged: true,
  created: 0,
});

const fontA = font(2007, "Font A");
const fontB = font(2042, "Font B");

const text = (fontFamily: number, isDeleted = false) =>
  API.createElement({
    type: "text",
    text: "hello",
    fontFamily,
    isDeleted,
  }) as ExcalidrawTextElement;

describe("exporting drawings with custom fonts (#140)", () => {
  beforeAll(() => {
    // the jsdom `document.fonts` mock from setupTests.ts has no `delete`
    Object.assign(window.document.fonts, { delete: vi.fn() });
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(fontA.id);
    Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(fontB.id);
  });

  describe("SVG export", () => {
    const exportSvg = (elements: ExcalidrawTextElement[]) =>
      exportUtils.exportToSvg(
        elements,
        { exportBackground: false, viewBackgroundColor: "#fff", files: {} },
        null,
      );

    it("embeds the custom font as an inline @font-face", async () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);

      const svg = await exportSvg([text(fontA.id)]);
      const css = svg.querySelector("style")?.textContent ?? "";

      expect(css).toContain(
        "@font-face { font-family: ExcalidrawCustomFont-2007; src: url(data:",
      );
    }, 30_000);

    it("renders the text with the custom font family", async () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);

      const svg = await exportSvg([text(fontA.id)]);

      expect(svg.querySelector("text")?.getAttribute("font-family")).toBe(
        "ExcalidrawCustomFont-2007, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji",
      );
    }, 30_000);

    it("doesn't embed custom fonts the exported text doesn't use", async () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);

      const svg = await exportSvg([text(FONT_FAMILY.Nunito)]);

      expect(svg.outerHTML).not.toContain("ExcalidrawCustomFont");
    }, 30_000);
  });

  describe("license notice", () => {
    it("isn't shown when no custom font is used", () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);

      const { container } = render(
        <CustomFontsLicenseNotice elements={[text(FONT_FAMILY.Excalifont)]} />,
      );

      expect(container.innerHTML).toBe("");
    });

    it("names the custom fonts the exported text uses", () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontB);

      render(
        <CustomFontsLicenseNotice
          elements={[text(fontA.id), text(fontB.id)]}
        />,
      );

      expect(screen.getByRole("note").textContent).toBe(
        "This drawing uses custom fonts (Font A, Font B). They're embedded in what you export, so only share it if their licenses allow it.",
      );
    });

    it("ignores fonts only used by deleted text", () => {
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);
      Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontB);

      render(
        <CustomFontsLicenseNotice
          elements={[text(fontA.id), text(fontB.id, true)]}
        />,
      );

      expect(screen.getByRole("note").textContent).toContain("(Font A)");
    });

    it.each(["imageExport", "jsonExport"] as const)(
      "is shown in the %s dialog",
      async (dialog) => {
        await render(<Excalidraw />);
        Fonts.registerCustomFont(fontA);
        API.setElements([text(fontA.id)]);

        API.setAppState({ openDialog: { name: dialog } });

        await waitFor(() => {
          expect(screen.getByRole("note").textContent).toContain("(Font A)");
        });
        expect(h.state.openDialog?.name).toBe(dialog);
      },
    );
  });
});
```

```typescript
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

import { getDefaultAppState } from "../appState";
import { loadFromBlob } from "../data/blob";
import { serializeAsJSON } from "../data/json";
import { Fonts } from "../fonts";
import * as exportUtils from "../scene/export";

import { API } from "./helpers/api";

import type {
  ExcalidrawTextElement,
  NonDeleted,
} from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import type { CustomFontData, DataURL } from "../types";

// a real WOFF2 file stands in for an uploaded font (see customFontsExport)
const WOFF2_BYTES = fs.readFileSync(
  path.resolve(
    __dirname,
    "../fonts/Excalifont/Excalifont-Regular-be310b9bcd4f1a43f571c46df7809174.woff2",
  ),
);

const font: CustomFontData = {
  id: 2007,
  name: "Font A",
  mimeType: "font/woff2",
  dataURL: `data:font/woff2;base64,${WOFF2_BYTES.toString(
    "base64",
  )}` as DataURL,
  licenseAcknowledged: true,
  created: 0,
};

// Cyrillic, Greek, Arabic, Hebrew, Devanagari, CJK, Hangul and an emoji
const MULTI_SCRIPT = "Привет Γειά مرحبا שלום नमस्ते 你好 こんにちは 안녕 👋";

const text = (value: string) =>
  API.createElement({
    type: "text",
    text: value,
    fontFamily: font.id,
  }) as NonDeleted<ExcalidrawTextElement>;

const exportSvg = (elements: NonDeleted<ExcalidrawTextElement>[]) =>
  exportUtils.exportToSvg(
    elements,
    { exportBackground: false, viewBackgroundColor: "#fff" },
    null,
  );

describe("custom fonts with other writing systems (#140, criterion E)", () => {
  beforeAll(() => {
    // the jsdom `document.fonts` mock from setupTests.ts has no `delete`
    Object.assign(window.document.fonts, { delete: vi.fn() });
  });

  beforeEach(() => {
    Fonts.registerCustomFont(font);
    // the jsdom FontFace mock hard-codes a Latin-1 unicode range, whereas
    // browsers default to the whole of Unicode for a FontFace without one
    Object.assign(Fonts.registered.get(font.id)!.fontFaces[0].fontFace, {
      unicodeRange: "U+0-10FFFF",
    });
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(font.id);
  });

  it("keeps text in many scripts intact in SVG export", async () => {
    const svg = await exportSvg([text(MULTI_SCRIPT)]);

    expect(svg.querySelector("text")?.textContent).toBe(MULTI_SCRIPT);
  }, 30_000);

  it("embeds the custom font for text written entirely in another script", async () => {
    const svg = await exportSvg([text("Привет мир")]);

    expect(svg.querySelector("style")?.textContent).toContain(
      "@font-face { font-family: ExcalidrawCustomFont-2007; src: url(data:",
    );
  }, 30_000);

  it("falls back to system fonts for characters the custom font lacks", async () => {
    const svg = await exportSvg([text("你好 👋")]);

    // the custom font first, then a generic font and an emoji font, so
    // missing glyphs render instead of showing as empty boxes
    expect(svg.querySelector("text")?.getAttribute("font-family")).toBe(
      "ExcalidrawCustomFont-2007, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji",
    );
  }, 30_000);

  it("keeps the text and its font when the drawing is saved and reopened", async () => {
    const json = serializeAsJSON(
      [text(MULTI_SCRIPT)],
      getDefaultAppState(),
      {},
      "local",
    );
    Fonts.unregisterCustomFont(font.id);

    const { elements } = await loadFromBlob(
      new Blob([json], { type: "application/json" }),
      null,
      null,
    );
    const restored = elements[0] as ExcalidrawTextElement;

    expect(restored.originalText).toBe(MULTI_SCRIPT);
    expect(restored.fontFamily).toBe(font.id);
    expect(Fonts.getCustomFonts()).toEqual([font]);
  });
});
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-13 03:49:10Z)**_

A little, but not badly. There are about 117 tests across the 9 test files. Most of them earn their place: each mutant we ran was caught by a specific test, and many of the larger groups are cheap table-driven cases. There are a few real overlaps, though:

**Real redundancy (about 10 tests you could cut):**

1. **The fallback font string is checked three times:** step 1's `getFontFamilyString` test, step 7 "SVG text uses the custom font family", and step 8 "falls back to system fonts". All three assert the same `ExcalidrawCustomFont-2007, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji`. I'd keep the step 1 unit test and the step 8 one, which explains _why_ the fallback matters, and drop step 7's.
2. **"Ignore deleted text" is checked at three levels:** `getCustomFontsUsedBy` (unit), the save tests, and the license notice tests. All three call the same function. Keep the unit test and drop the other two.
3. **Step 5's integration tests repeat step 4's dialog tests.** "Leaves everything unchanged when cancelled" and "TTF shows an error" repeat what step 4 already covers at the component level. Each could shrink to a single check that the editor wires the dialog up.
4. **Step 8's save-and-reopen test** is mostly 6a's round-trip test with different text. The only new part is that non-Latin text survives, which JSON guarantees anyway.
5. **The three step 8 SVG tests each run a full export** with real font subsetting, which takes a few seconds per test. They could share one export and check three things.

**Not bloat, even though it's a lot:**

- **`restoreCustomFonts` (22 tests):** most of these are one-line table rows, one per kind of bad input. File loading takes untrusted input, so each rejection rule is worth a row.
- **Step 4's 16 dialog tests:** each covers a distinct rule (license gating, blank names, Enter key, each error message). Several were the only test catching a mutant.

**Overall:** trimming would remove roughly 8–10 tests and a few seconds of run time, without losing any mutant kills. Since your PR is due soon, I'd leave them as they are. Overlap from testing each step at its own level is normal, and the Test Evidence tables already map tests to criteria. If you want them trimmed anyway, I can do it as a separate small commit.
